Same abbreviation/full-form problem the glossary already flags for བསྡུ་བ and གཟུགས་ཀྱི་སྐུ — worth one covering entry rather than a third ad-hoc case.

p0217 l3, in the definition (བགྲོད་པར་བྱ་བ་མིན་པའི་བུད་མེད) and three times in the Aśvaghoṣa verse (བགྲོད་པར་བྱ་མིན, བགྲོད་བྱ་མིན་པ). No entry. Kept separable from འཇུག་པར་བྱ་བ་མིན་པ; if the glossary decides to merge them, both must change together.

p0217 l3 (list), p0218 l1 (heading and definition). Third of the four bases. No entry. Deliberately kept separable from ཡུལ་མིན in the Aśvaghoṣa verse ('nơi chốn' vs 'xứ') because the verse uses a different Tibetan word inside a quotation; a ruling should preserve that distinction rather than collapse it.

p0218 l1, དེ་ལ་ཡུལ་མིན་བྱ་བ་ནི and ཡུལ་མིན་དེ་རུ་མི་བྱ་འོ. Verse-internal variant of གནས་མིན་པ; rendered 'chẳng phải xứ' so the quotation is not silently normalised to the commentary's word. No entry — needs registering alongside གནས་མིན་པ.

terms.vi: Việc tu tập về khổ thực sự
terms.note: This chunk's section heading (sectionPath 6.2.3.1.4.2.1.1.2). དངོས rendered 'thực sự', following the only registered precedent — c028's སྐྱོང་ཚུལ་དངོས = 'Cách thức hộ trì thực sự'. 'chính thức' / 'chính phần' would read more naturally in Vietnamese; if the project prefers one of those, c028 and this heading must move together.

terms.vi: Tư duy về khổ chung của luân hồi / Tư duy về khổ riêng biệt
terms.note: The two-fold division announced on p0268. བསམ་པ here is the verbal noun 'to contemplate', rendered 'tư duy về' so it stays distinct from བསྒོམ་པ = 'tu tập' and from དཔྱད་པ = 'quán sát'. NOTE the collision: glossary.json fixes བསམ་པ (āśaya) = 'ý lạc'; that is the noun sense and does not apply here. The same heading pattern recurs for སྡུག་བསྔལ་བརྒྱད/དྲུག/གསུམ་བསམ་པ.
Third-level heading on p0268; siblings སྡུག་བསྔལ་དྲུག་བསམ་པ = 'Tư duy về sáu khổ' and སྡུག་བསྔལ་གསུམ་བསམ་པ = 'Tư duy về ba khổ' are named in the division but fall in later chunks.

p0268, the abbreviation of སྡུག་བསྔལ་གྱི་བདེན་པ; 16× in the corpus (also on p0267, just outside this chunk). Consistent with the glossary's འཕགས་པའི་བདེན་པ་བཞི = 'bốn thánh đế'. The parallel abbreviations ཀུན་འབྱུང / འགོག་བདེན / ལམ་བདེན occur on p0267 and need the same treatment.

p0268, in the Suhṛllekha verse and twice in the commentary on it. The commentary makes the identification certain: it is the first of the 'four shown directly', the other three being འཆི་བ / ན་བ / རྒ་བ, so this is the eighth of the eight sufferings (not getting what one wants). Rendered literally from the Tibetan rather than with the Chinese-derived 'cầu bất đắc', which the Tibetan does not say.
p0268, first word of the Suhṛllekha citation. Read as the vocative addressing the letter's royal recipient — confirmed inside the verse by the honorific imperative སྐྱོ་མཛད. See flag.

terms.vi: Kinh Tu Tập Lòng Tin Nơi Đại Thừa
terms.note: p0269; 4× in the corpus. Title translated literally, element by element: ཐེག་པ་ཆེན་པོ = Đại thừa (glossary), དད་པ = lòng tin (glossary), བསྒོམ་པ = tu tập, མདོ = Kinh.

p0270. The Saṃdhinirmocana-sūtra, cited under its short Tibetan title; the interlocutor named in the quotation (བྱམས་པ / Maitreya) fixes the identification. Given the established Vietnamese title 'Giải Thâm Mật' (解深密); འཕགས་པ = 'Thánh' is in the Tibetan and kept, and no word for 'Kinh' was supplied because the Tibetan has none here. See flag: glossary.json already carries དགོངས་འགྲེལ = 'luận giải mật ý' as a common noun.

p0268, འབྲིང་དང་ཐུན་མོང་བའི་དམིགས་སྐོར་སྐྱོང་བ. Only 2× in the whole corpus. Built from the glossary's དམིགས་པ = 'sở duyên' plus སྐོར = vòng/loạt. སྐྱོང་བ rendered 'duy trì', following the glossary's སྐྱོང་བ/བསྐྱང་བ = 'duy trì' entry (the sense here is sustaining a meditation object, not guarding a practice).

p0269, glossing what ཞི་གནས consists of. No glossary entry; 'nhất tâm' is already the corpus form (c004, c013, c023, c056), against 'chuyên nhất' in c014/c033. Both are live and unregistered — a ruling is needed.
p0268, ཐར་པ་དོན་གཉེར་ཡང་རློམ་པ་ཙམ་དུ་ཟད་པ. Follows the corpus form in c007/c031/c078.

terms.vi: một cách nối liền không dứt
terms.note: p0269. Occurs exactly ONCE in the whole 978-page corpus. Read as a spelling of འབྲེང་ཆགས / རྒྱུན་ཆགས = continuous, unbroken. See flag.

terms.vi: các loài ở địa ngục hữu tình
terms.note: p0270 l.3. The inhabitant form (`པ` + plural) of the registered `སེམས་ཅན་དམྱལ་བ` = "địa ngục hữu tình" (provisional). c083 originally reversed the order to "các hữu tình địa ngục"; now aligned to the registered order with "các loài ở…" supplying the `པ` nominaliser. A ruling on how the `པ` form is to be rendered would fix this for the hell chapters, where it is frequent.

p0270 l.1, in the definition of vipaśyanā (`དགེ་བའི་དམིགས་པ་ལ་སོ་སོར་དཔྱོད་པའི་ཇི་ལྟ་བ་དང་ཇི་སྙེད་པ་འབྱེད་པ`). No entry. c083 first rendered it "sự giản trạch từng phần", colliding with the registered `སོ་སོར་རྟོག་པ` = "giản trạch" eleven lines earlier in the same chunk; changed to "sự quán sát từng phần", following the corpus's own `དཔྱད/དཔྱོད` → "quán sát" (cf. `དཔྱད་སྒོམ` = "tu theo lối quán sát"). Needs a ruling that fixes the split between the two `སོ་སོར་…` terms; they stand side by side in the śamatha/vipaśyanā definitions and will keep meeting.

p0270 l.1, ×2, two sentences after `ཞི་གནས་དང་ལྷག་མཐོང` → "tịnh chỉ và thắng quán". Both forms are inside the fixed-set viVariants, so nothing is out of set, and the existing provisional `ཞི་ལྷག` = "chỉ quán" entry licenses the compact form. But decisions.md §1 grants bare `chỉ`/`quán` only "inside the fixed compound chỉ quán (`ཟུང་འབྲེལ` — union)", and §1 also says "keep one choice stable within a single section" — while `ཞི་ལྷག` is the abbreviation of the pair, not `ཟུང་འབྲེལ`. Kept (mirroring the Tibetan's own abbreviation with the Vietnamese compact form). The `ཞི་ལྷག` entry and decisions.md §1 should state explicitly that `ཞི་ལྷག` takes "chỉ quán" and that this does not violate the register-matching rule.

p0269, inside the sūtra quotation `རིགས་ཀྱི་བུ་རྣམ་གྲངས་འདིས་ཀྱང` → "cũng do pháp môn này". No entry. "pháp môn" is the conventional rendering of paryāya, but the sense in this quotation is closer to "this line of reasoning / this way of putting it"; the term recurs across the book in both senses, so it needs a ruling that says which Vietnamese covers which. Kept as is pending that ruling.

terms.vi: một cách nối liền không dứt
terms.note: p0269, `བྲེང་ཆགས་སུ་བསྒོམ་སྟེ`. No entry, and the source form is itself irregular — a hapax in the corpus, almost certainly the print's error for `རྒྱུན་ཆགས` (attested at p0169, p0240, p0497, p0547). Per CLAUDE.md the source was not normalised; the chunk now carries an inline translator's note recording the oddity and that the rendering follows the `རྒྱུན་ཆགས` reading. Needs both a glossary entry and a place in the typo register.

terms.vi: Kinh Tổng Trì Tự Tại Vương Thỉnh Vấn
terms.note: p0134, source of the jeweler simile (Tsongkhapa declines to quote it in full). Built from the glossary's fixed parts: གཟུངས = tổng trì (the Tibetan translates rather than transliterates, so the term-level ruling applies), དབང་ཕྱུག = Tự Tại, རྒྱལ་པོ = Vương, ཞུས་པ = thỉnh vấn — matching the pattern of དཔུང་བཟང་གིས་ཞུས་པ / སེང་གེས་ཞུས་པ. Not verified against an existing Vietnamese edition.

p0134, cited as author of སྤྱོད་པ་བསྡུས་པའི་སྒྲོན་མེ. Established Sino-Vietnamese (聖天), following the pattern of the fixed ཀླུ་སྒྲུབ = Long Thọ and ཐོགས་མེད = Vô Trước. འཕགས་པ is absorbed into 'Thánh', so no separate 'bậc thánh' prefix. The glossary already has བཞི་བརྒྱ་པ = Tứ Bách Luận noted as his work but no entry for the author.

p0135, as སློབ་དཔོན་ཆེན་པོ་ཟླ་བ་གྲགས་པ → 'đại A-xà-lê Nguyệt Xứng'. Established Sino-Vietnamese (月稱). The glossary holds his works (དབུ་མ་ལ་འཇུག་པ, ཕར་ཕྱིན་གྱི་འགྲེལ་བཤད་ཚིག་གསལ་བ) but no entry for the author himself.
p0133. Established Sino-Vietnamese (增上慢). Distinct from the existing ང་རྒྱལ = ngã mạn and ཆེ་བའི་ང་རྒྱལ = mạn tự cho mình lớn.

p0134, attributed here to འཕགས་པ་ལྷ. Same Vietnamese as the existing glossary entry སྤྱོད་བསྡུས་སྒྲོན་མ = 'Nhiếp Hành Đăng' (p0123), which is recorded there as Atiśa's. Registered as a title variant; see flag — the two may be different works with near-identical Tibetan titles.
p0135, inside the Nhiếp Hành Đăng verse. Same Vietnamese as the existing དོན་དམ་པ = thắng nghĩa; registered because the Tibetan word order differs.
p0135, སེམས་ཅན་དང་པོའི་ལས་ཅན་རྣམས → 'các chúng sinh sơ nghiệp'. Established Sino-Vietnamese (初業) for a beginner-practitioner.

terms.vi: Cách thức lấy tinh túy — phần chính
terms.note: Outline path 6.2.3, p0135. Built on c039's སྙིང་པོ་ཇི་ལྟར་ལེན་པའི་ཚུལ = 'Cách thức lấy tinh túy như thế nào', with དངོས rendered 'phần chính' following c040's རྒྱུ་མཚན་དངོས = 'Lý do chính'. See flag: c043 renders དངོས as 'thực sự' in a sibling heading.

terms.vi: Thứ đệ của đạo cộng thông với bậc hạ
terms.note: Outline path 6.2.3.1, p0135. Wording taken to match c080 l.99, the closing colophon of this very section ('Phần tu tâm nơi thứ đệ của đạo cộng thông với bậc hạ đã giảng xong'), rather than the glossary's general རིམ་པ = 'trình tự'.
Outline path 6.2.2.1.2.2.2, p0133. Sibling of རྒྱུ་མཚན་དངོས = 'Lý do chính' (c040), so the pair reads 'lý do' / 'mục đích'.

p0135, as སློབ་དཔོན་མཁས་པ་མ་ཁོལ → 'A-xà-lê, bậc học giả Mātṛceṭa'. Combines the existing སློབ་དཔོན་མ་ཁོལ = 'A-xà-lê Mātṛceṭa' with མཁས་པ = 'bậc học giả'. Third epithet form recorded for this author, after སློབ་དཔོན་མ་ཁོལ and དཔལ་ལྡན་མ་ཁོལ.

p0135 l.1, Catuḥśataka verse `བསོད་ནམས་མིན་པ་དང་པོར་བཟློག`. Negated form of the fixed headword `བསོད་ནམས` = phúc đức; recorded so the negation keeps the full fixed word rather than collapsing to 'phi phúc'. Text was corrected to 'phi phúc đức' in this repair.

p0135 l.1, in the Āryadeva verse `ཐབས་འདི་རྫོགས་པའི་སངས་རྒྱས་ཀྱིས`. The glossary fixes only the full form `ཡང་དག་པར་རྫོགས་པའི་སངས་རྒྱས` = Chánh Đẳng Chánh Giác; the short form has no ruling. Wording kept per the gap rule, but it differs from the fixed string by one word and will read as drift in the Phase 5 sweep unless recorded as the distinct short form.

p0134 l.3, printed in the locative as `སྤྱོད་པ་བསྡུས་པའི་སྒྲོན་མེར`. Āryadeva's work. No entry; the cited-title rule in decisions.md requires closing the title at first occurrence. Element-by-element rendering: སྤྱོད་པ = hành, བསྡུས་པ = nhiếp, སྒྲོན་མ = đăng.
Outline s104, path 6.2.3.1.4.2.1.2.1.1, level 9 → '#'. ངོས་བཟུང་བ = 'nhận diện' follows c055 (སྐྱབས་ཀྱི་ཡུལ་ངོས་བཟུང = 'nhận diện đối tượng').

terms.vi: Trình tự sinh khởi của phiền não
terms.note: Outline s105, path 6.2.3.1.4.2.1.2.1.2, level 9 → '#'. Sibling of s104, so same heading depth.

Sixth of the ten root afflictions, p0296. The contracted form འཇིག་ལྟ (p0295, p0296, p0297 ×3) is rendered identically. 'hoại tụ kiến' (壞聚見) chosen over 'thân kiến' / 'tát-ca-da kiến' precisely because the text glosses its two members etymologically — འཇིག་པ་ནི་མི་རྟག་པ (hoại = vô thường), ཚོགས་པ་ནི་དུ་མ (tụ = nhiều) — and only a rendering built on the same two components lets that gloss read.
Seventh of the ten, p0296. The contracted མཐར་ལྟ in the eighth definition is rendered identically.

Eighth of the ten, p0296. Established Sino-Vietnamese (見取). Paired with giới cấm thủ so the two 'holding-as-supreme' views stay visibly a pair. Note the bare verbal མཆོག་ཏུ་འཛིན་པ at p0297 is rendered descriptively ('sự chấp làm tối thắng'), not with the noun 'kiến thủ', because there it takes ác hạnh as its object as well.
Ninth of the ten, p0296-p0297. Established Sino-Vietnamese (戒禁取). Inside the definition the two members are kept as the glossary has them: ཚུལ་ཁྲིམས = giới, བརྟུལ་ཞུགས = cấm hạnh.
p0296, the object of hoại tụ kiến. Established Sino-Vietnamese (取蘊).
No entry existed. p0296 (×3), p0297 (×2). Kept distinct from the glossary's རིན་པོ་ཆེའི་ཕུང་པོ = Kinh Bảo Uẩn, where ཕུང་པོ is 'heap'.

p0297, third of the three sources named for the ten-affliction list. Rendered from the Tibetan components (ཕུང་པོ་ལྔ = ngũ uẩn, རབ་བྱེད = luận/prakaraṇa). The established Vietnamese title of Vasubandhu's text is *Đại Thừa Ngũ Uẩn Luận*, but the Tibetan has no word for 'Đại Thừa', so it was not added. Not verified against a Vietnamese edition — see flags.

p0297 (×2), in the rope-and-snake simile: ཐག་པའི་གནས་ལུགས་མི་གསལ་བ and ཕུང་པོའི་གནས་ལུགས་གསལ་བ་ལ་སྒྲིབ་པ. 11 occurrences in the whole corpus. Deliberately not 'thật tướng' (which would collide with མཚན་ཉིད = tướng) — but it sits close to the fixed རང་བཞིན = tự tánh; see flags.

Used five times in the ten-affliction definitions, always as ཤེས་རབ་ཉོན་མོངས་ཅན ('afflicted prajñā') except under མ་རིག་པ where it qualifies མི་ཤེས་པ. Rendered adjectivally so the head noun ཤེས་རབ = trí tuệ (glossary) survives intact rather than being collapsed into 'nhiễm ô tuệ'.
p0295, three times inside the Abhidharmasamuccaya definition of an affliction. རབ་ཏུ rendered 'hết sức' each time so the intensifier is not dropped.

p0295, inside the Pramāṇavārttika verse (ལྷན་ཅིག་བྱེད་པ་ཟད་ཕྱིར་རོ). The prose two lines earlier on p0294 has the full ལྷན་ཅིག་བྱེད་རྐྱེན, which the glossary registers as 'trợ duyên'. The verse form lacks རྐྱེན, so 'duyên' is bracketed rather than absorbed.
p0296, in རྟག་པ་ཐེར་ཟུག་པ (the eternalist half of biên kiến). Paired with རྟག་པ = thường hằng; two Tibetan words kept as two Vietnamese words.
p0295, the verb in the definition of འདོད་ཆགས. རྗེས་སུ ('following after') kept as 'theo' so it is not flattened into the headword tham ái.

p0295, in the definition of ཁོང་ཁྲོ་བ. Not new in itself — it matches the existing glossary entry ཀུན་ནས་མནར་སེམས (from p0220, harsh speech) — recorded only to confirm the same rendering was carried into the root-affliction definition.
p0295, apposed to ཀུན་ནས་མནར་སེམས་པ in the same definition. Given its own Vietnamese word so the source's two juxtaposed descriptions stay two.

terms.vi: ཁེངས་པ = tự cao (kiêu căng) / ང་རྒྱལ = ngã mạn
terms.note: COLLISION, needs one paired ruling; not a c091-only edit. glossary.json currently assigns "ngã mạn" to BOTH ཁེངས་པ and ང་རྒྱལ (both provisional), and the ང་རྒྱལ entry's own note already flags this. In c091 the two occur inside one sentence: ང་རྒྱལ་ནི། … སེམས་ཁེངས་པ་སྟེ (p0296 l.1) — applying the ཁེངས་པ entry literally yields the circular "Ngã mạn: … mà tâm ngã mạn", collapsing the definiendum into its definition. They collide again at p0297 l.7 (བདག་ལ་དམིགས་ནས་ཁེངས་པ་ཡང་སྐྱེ་ལ) inside the list where ང་རྒྱལ is one of the ten afflictions. c091 keeps ང་རྒྱལ = "ngã mạn" (the affliction's name, matching the entry) and ཁེངས་པ = "tâm tự cao" (the mental act). Requesting a ruling that keeps them visibly distinct.

No entry exists (glossary registers only ལྟ་བ => kiến). c091 is where the ten afflictions are defined, so this and its siblings should be registered here. Already matches c093/c097/c098/c103. The Tibetan's own gloss of the name (འཇིག་པ = mi rtag pa, ཚོགས་པ = du ma) is translated in the body, which the compact Sino-Vietnamese form supports.
No entry (p0296 l.9, p0296 l.11). Standard Sino-Vietnamese form; register with the other four views.
No entry, despite being one of the ten afflictions defined here (p0296 l.3) and the root of the whole sequence (p0297 l.7, མ་རིག་པའི་མུན་པ). Standard rendering; register.

p0264-p0265, 3×. Built on the glossary's ཉེར་ལེན་གྱི་རྒྱུ = 'nhân cận thủ' (c028) so ཉེར་ལེན stays 'cận thủ' throughout, and on ཕུང་པོ = uẩn (cf. རིན་པོ་ཆེའི་ཕུང་པོ = Kinh Bảo Uẩn). The commoner Vietnamese 'thủ uẩn' was not used, to keep the ཉེར་ལེན compound visibly one word across the corpus.
p0264, སྐྱེ་གནས་ཀྱི་སྒོ་ནས་མངལ་ལ་སོགས་པ་བཞི — the fourfold division by mode of birth. མངལ rendered 'thai sinh', consistent with the glossary's བརྫུས་ཏེ་སྐྱེ་བ = hóa sinh.
p0264. The glossary's ཁམས = 'Kham' is a place name and must NOT apply here; this follows ཁམས་གོང་མ་གཉིས = 'hai giới trên'.

p0264, འགྲོ་བས་ཕྱེ་ན་ལྔའམ་དྲུག = 'nếu phân theo thú thì năm hoặc sáu'. Uses the glossary's འགྲོ་བ་ལྔ = 'ngũ thú', NOT the bare འགྲོ་བ = 'chúng sinh' entry, which would make the sentence unreadable here.
p0265, sa-bcad item (the sibling of this chunk's section). རྟེན་འབྲེལ = 'duyên khởi', already used in c073 and c080.
p0265-p0267, ~10×. Completes the set already registered as འགོག་པའི་བདེན་པ = diệt đế and ལམ་གྱི་བདེན་པ = đạo đế.

p0265-p0267. Bare ཀུན་འབྱུང in prose apposition rendered 'tập'; inside the sūtra quotation (ཀུན་འབྱུང་འཕགས་པའི་བདེན་པ) rendered 'thánh đế về tập khởi', following the glossary's སྡུག་བསྔལ་ཀུན་འབྱུང = 'sự tập khởi của khổ'.
p0266. Deliberate divergence from the glossary's ཟག་པ (in ཟག་པ་ཆུང་འབྲིང) = 'sai phạm': there ཟག་པ is a Vinaya lapse, here ཟག་བཅས is āsrava, so 'hữu lậu' is required.
p0266, 2×, named as ཉོན་མོངས་ཀྱི་རྩ་བ.
p0266. NOT the glossary's ཡི་དམ = 'bổn tôn' (iṣṭadevatā): here ཡི་དམ་འཆའ་བ is the idiom 'to make a firm resolve/pledge'. Registered so a sweep never conflates the two.
p0266-p0267, 4×. Consistent with c009/c035/c057/c058.
p0267, ཞེན་ལོག་རྣལ་མ = 'tâm chán lìa chân thật'. Registered centrally: already de facto settled in c033, c039, c049, c053, c054 but has no glossary entry.
p0266 (ཉམས་ལེན་གྱི་གནད་ཆེན་པོ) and p0267 (ཉམས་ལེན་གྱི་འགག་སྡོམ). No glossary entry; kept distinct from སྒྲུབ་པ.

terms.vi: chỗ thâu tóm điểm hiểm yếu
terms.note: p0267, ཉམས་ལེན་གྱི་འགག་སྡོམ་ཡང་ཆེ་བས. Obscure idiom (འགག = crux/bottleneck, སྡོམ = gathering-up/summary), rendered descriptively. See flag — NOT verified.
p0267, འབེན་མ་མཐོང་བའི་མདའ་བརྡེག་པ་ལྟར = 'như bắn tên mà chẳng thấy bia'.
p0267. Rendered literally rather than 'Đại thừa và Tiểu thừa', because the Tibetan writes ཆུང (small), not ཐེག་དམན, which the glossary already fixes as 'Tiểu thừa'.
p0266, vocative inside the Catuḥśataka verse (བྱིས་ཁྱོད). Follows c015's 'kẻ ấu trĩ'; c056 has 'hàng phàm ngu' for the same root — the two need unifying.

terms.vi: Nhận biết cái trí mong cầu giải thoát
terms.note: Outline s091, path 6.2.3.1.4.1, level 5 → '##'. Built strictly from precedent: 'X དོན་གཉེར་གྱི་བློ' = 'cái trí mong cầu X' per c043's heading for འཇིག་རྟེན་ཕྱི་མ་དོན་གཉེར་གྱི་བློ; ངོས་བཟུང་བ = 'nhận biết' per c035's དལ་འབྱོར་ངོས་བཟུང་བ.

terms.vi: Phương tiện phát khởi cái trí mong cầu giải thoát
terms.note: Outline s092, level 5 → '##'. ཐབས = 'phương tiện' per the existing provisional entry.

terms.vi: Quán xét qua cửa khổ và tập
terms.note: Outline s093, level 6 → '###'. བསམ་པ in the verbal sa-bcad sense = 'quán xét', per the registered བསམ་པ (verbal-noun sense) from c045.

terms.vi: Quán xét lỗi hại của luân hồi, tức khổ đế
terms.note: Outline s094, level 7 → '####'. ཉེས་དམིགས = 'lỗi hại' per glossary. Its sibling ཀུན་འབྱུང་འཁོར་བའི་འཇུག་རིམ་བསམ་པ (announced in this range, headed later) = 'Quán xét thứ lớp thể nhập luân hồi, tức tập đế'.

terms.vi: Trình bày mật ý của việc dạy khổ đế trước nhất trong bốn chân đế
terms.note: Outline s095, level 8 → '#####'. དགོངས་པ = 'mật ý' and བདེན་བཞི = 'bốn chân đế', both per glossary.

terms.kind: doctrinal — ruling needed for the bare term
terms.note: No entry for bare ཀུན་འབྱུང; glossary has only སྡུག་བསྔལ་ཀུན་འབྱུང => 'sự tập khởi của khổ', whose note asserts in passing that bare ཀུན་འབྱུང = 'sự tập khởi' but does not register it as an entry. Wording KEPT per the no-ruling rule. The chunk uses two forms, each traceable: 'tập' where the Tibetan pairs it with སྡུག་བསྔལ/སྡུག་བདེན as a member of a list or a section heading (p0265 l.3 སྡུག་བསྔལ་དང་ཀུན་འབྱུང་གི་སྒོ་ནས, c082 l.47; p0265 l.7 heading, l.52; p0266 ཀུན་འབྱུང་གི་བདེན་པ, l.88; p0267 ཀུན་འབྱུང་བསམས་པའི་སྒོ་ནས and སྤང་བྱ་སྡུག་ཀུན, l.121, l.124) and 'tập khởi' where it stands alone as a full nominal (p0265 l.15 quotation འདི་ནི་ཀུན་འབྱུང་འཕགས་པའི་བདེན་པའོ, c082 l.64; p0267 ཅི་བྱས་ཀུན་འབྱུང་དུ་འགྲོ, l.121). This is a section-heading term and one of the four truths, so it needs one ruling — ideally 'tập' for the compact truth-name (khổ đế / tập đế / diệt đế / đạo đế) and 'tập khởi' where the Tibetan gives the word its own weight — before the split hardens across the book.

terms.skt: śānta / upaśānta (here śama / upaśama, verbal noun)
terms.kind: scope — existing entries need widening, no wording change
terms.note: Text was ALIGNED to the recorded entries, so nothing diverges any more; this is a request to confirm the scope rather than a gap in the rendering. Both entries were recorded from the ten qualities of a teacher (ཞི་བ glossed ཏིང་ངེ་འཛིན་གྱི་བསླབ་པ, ཉེ་བར་ཞི་བ glossed ཤེས་རབ་ཀྱི་བསླབ་པ), i.e. as adjectives describing a person. In c082 both are verbal nouns governing an object — སྡུག་བསྔལ་ཞི་བ, སྡུག་བསྔལ་ཉེ་བར་ཞི་བ ('the pacification of suffering'). Same root, different grammatical use, and the entries as written do not say whether they reach it. Please widen them explicitly (or add scoped sub-entries) so the next chunk does not have to re-decide.

Section heading s100, path 6.2.3.1.4.2.1.1.2.1.3. བསྒོམ་པ = 'tu tập' per the glossary's བསྒོམ་པའི་རིམ་པ = Tu Tập Thứ Đệ; kept deliberately distinct from the sibling headings' བསམ་པ (སྡུག་བསྔལ་བརྒྱད/དྲུག་བསམ་པ), which the corpus renders 'suy xét' (c049).

No glossary entry. Follows established corpus practice (c030 l.122, c057 l.115, c065 l.47/50 all render ཚོར་བ 'cảm thọ'). The three: ཚོར་བ་བདེ་བ = 'cảm thọ lạc', ཚོར་བ་སྡུག་བསྔལ = 'cảm thọ khổ', ཚོར་བ་བཏང་སྙོམས = 'cảm thọ xả'; ཚོར་བ་གསུམ = 'ba cảm thọ'.
p0287, p0288. བཏང་སྙོམས is unregistered anywhere in the glossary. Rendered 'xả' rather than the descriptive 'bất khổ bất lạc' so the three-member set stays parallel in form.
p0288. ཀུན་ཏུ་འགྲོ་བ = 遍行 'biến hành', the standard Abhidharma rendering. Built on the གནས་ངན་ལེན entry above; the two must be fixed together.

p0287, in ཡུལ་ཟག་བཅས་རྣམས = 'các đối tượng hữu lậu' and ཟག་པ་དང་བཅས་པའི་ཚོར་བ་བཏང་སྙོམས = 'cảm thọ xả hữu lậu'. Here ཟག་པ IS āsrava, so 'lậu' applies — deliberately unlike the glossary's ཟག་པ་ཆུང་འབྲིང entry, which rules 'lậu' out for a different (vow-infraction) sense of the same word. Register both so the split is visible.
p0287. Standard pair; unregistered.
p0287, དེ་དང་མཚུངས་པར་ལྡན་པའི་སེམས་སེམས་བྱུང་གཞན་རྣམས. Established Abhidharma term 相應.
p0289, inside the Garbhāvakrānti quotation. Built on the glossary's བསམ་གཏན = tĩnh lự (kept distinct from ཏིང་ངེ་འཛིན = định).

p0287, ཕོལ་མིག་གམ་འབྲས — hapax in the whole 978-page corpus, paired with འབྲས (rendered 'ung nhọt'). Read as a boil/swelling from the pairing and from the simile itself. NOT verified against a dictionary. See flag.
p0287, the simile for khổ khổ. Hapax in the corpus. མཁལ་མ = thận (kidney), ཟུག་གཟེར = piercing pain. Rendered descriptively; see flag.
p0287, ཚྭ་ཆུ་ལ་སོགས་པའི་འགྱུར་བྱེད་ཀྱི་རེག་པ. Rendered literally so its link to འགྱུར་བའི་སྡུག་བསྔལ stays visible.
p0288, cited beside རྣལ་འབྱོར་སྤྱོད་པའི་ས. glossary.json has the form without རྣམ་པར; the fuller Tibetan is given the same Vietnamese title.
p0289. ཕྱིར་བཅོས་པ = remedy/counteract. Rendered 'chữa trị' rather than 'đối trị', which is reserved for གཉེན་པོ.

terms.vi: an lạc do chính thể tánh của nó
terms.note: p0289, four occurrences; the pivot of the closing argument. Built on the glossary's ངོ་བོ = thể tánh, kept distinct from རང་བཞིན = tự tánh (fixed), which also occurs in this chunk (ཟད་ཅིང་འགོག་པའི་རང་བཞིན་ཅན = 'có tự tánh cạn kiệt và diệt tận').

p0287 and p0288, c088 l.36, l.51. No entry for བཏང་སྙོམས. Ruling needed now because of the collision with upekṣā as equanimity (the four immeasurables, the mental factor) elsewhere in the book — that sense will want a different Vietnamese word than the neutral-feeling sense here.

terms.vi: thể sền sệt / thể đặc lại / thể dài ra / thể tròn chắc / thể có tay chân mọc ra
terms.note: p0272, the five embryonic stages inside the Garbhāvakrānti quotation. Rendered descriptively from the Tibetan, which itself uses descriptive words, NOT by the Sino-Vietnamese transliterations (yết-la-lam / át-bộ-đàm / bế-thi / kiện-nam / bát-la-xa-khư), which would import Sanskrit the Tibetan does not write. A central ruling is owed before the set recurs.

p0274, རྨ་གསར་པ་ལྟ་བུ་བཟེ་རེ་ཅན. Reading fixed from the two other corpus occurrences: བཟེ་རེ་ཆེ་ན་སྡུག་བསྔལ་ཕྲ་མོ་ཤིན་ཏུ་... and བཅིང་དང་བརྡེག་སོགས་ལ། བདག་གིས་བཟེ་རེ་མི་བྱ, i.e. tenderness/squeamishness toward pain, not the pain itself.
p0275, Lalitavistara verse, སྡོང་པོ་གནམ་ལྕགས་ཀྱིས་ནི་བཅོམ་པ. Literal ('sắt trời'); rendered by its function in the simile. 'thiên thiết' was avoided as opaque.
p0273, inside the Kinh Nhập Thai quotation.
p0273, twice (once in the sūtra quotation, once in Tsongkhapa's summary). Rendered literally; the five are not enumerated in the source.
p0272, སྲོག་གི་དབང་པོ་ནི་མི་བརྟན.
p0274, the two pelvic bones pressing the newborn. Rendered literally (འཁྲུལ་འཁོར = máy/khí cụ); no interpretive 'xương chậu' supplied.
p0273, Śiṣyalekha verse.

terms.vi: suy xét nỗi khổ của già
terms.note: p0275. The second of the eight sufferings. བསམ་པ rendered 'suy xét' throughout; c083, which translates the parent headings (སྡུག་བསྔལ་བསམ་པ, འཁོར་བ་སྤྱིའི་སྡུག་བསྔལ་བསམ་པ, སྡུག་བསྔལ་བརྒྱད་བསམ་པ), is not yet written and must be made to agree. See flag.
p0275, simile for white hair. A Tibetan plant name; left in transcription rather than flattened to 'hoa trắng', which would delete the referent. See flag.

p0272, in the Kinh Nhập Thai quotation (སྲིན་གྲོལ་མ་བཞིན་མི་གཙང་བའི་ཁུ་བས་ནི་གསོ). Hapax in the corpus; a creature (སྲིན = worm/parasite) but not identified. Left in transcription with the neutral classifier 'loài'. See flag.
p0272, twice. Not identified with confidence — see flag. Rendered 'dịch não' in both places so the two occurrences stay linked.

CONFLICT, not a translator error — the wording in c084 was left as is. glossary.json carries the SAME work twice: `སློབ་སྤྲིངས` = 'Thư Gửi Đệ Tử' (provisional, from p0114) and `སློབ་མ་ལ་སྤྲིངས་པ` = 'Đệ Tử Thư' (provisional, from p0170). decisions.md requires one fixed Vietnamese title per cited work, so the two entries must be MERGED by a single central ruling, not resolved by rewriting this chunk. Recommend 'Đệ Tử Thư' as the surviving form: it has the corpus majority (5 files vs 3), it is what the immediately preceding chunk c083 uses for the long form on p0271, and it matches c081/c037/c108; it is also the form built on the settled precedent བཤེས་སྤྲིངས = Thân Hữu Thư (親友書 / 弟子書). Once ruled, the three files using 'Thư Gửi Đệ Tử' need a sweep.

p0275, the governing term of the new section `རྒ་བའི་སྡུག་བསྔལ་བསམ་པ`. No entry in glossary.json. Rendered plainly as 'già' and 'nỗi khổ của già'; kept, since 'lão' would clash with the plain-Vietnamese register already used for `སྐྱེ་བ` = 'sinh' and `འཆི་བ`. Needs one ruling before the whole aging section is written.

p0275, headword of the second of the five aging topics (`མཐུ་སྟོབས་ཡོངས་སུ་ཉམས་པ`). No entry. Rendered 'sức lực'; the Sino-Vietnamese alternative would be 'khí lực'. Kept; needs a ruling since it is a section headword.
p0275, L87, inside the first of the five aging topics (`ལང་ཚོ་ཉམས་ནས་མི་སྡུག་པར་འགྱུར་བ`). No entry. Rendered 'tuổi xuân'; alternatives 'thanh xuân' / 'sức thanh niên'. Kept; register centrally.

terms.vi: khổ vì gặp gỡ điều không đáng ưa
terms.note: p0278, fifth of the eight sufferings. Rendered descriptively rather than as the compact Sino-Vietnamese 'oán tắng hội khổ', following the precedent of དལ་འབྱོར and མི་ཁོམ་པ་བརྒྱད: the Tibetan here is an ordinary descriptive phrase, not a compressed technical label.

terms.vi: khổ vì lìa xa điều yêu quý
terms.note: p0278, sixth of the eight sufferings. Descriptive, not 'ái biệt ly khổ' — same reasoning as the entry above.

terms.vi: khổ vì tìm cầu điều mong muốn mà không được
terms.note: p0278-p0279, seventh of the eight sufferings. Descriptive, not 'cầu bất đắc khổ' — same reasoning.

p0277, second of the five aspects of the suffering of death (རྩ་འཇིང་སྡུག་པ་ཕུན་སུམ་ཚོགས་པ). Fixed off the only other occurrence in the corpus, p0243: གཉེན་ལ་སོགས་པའི་རྩ་འཇིང་ཆེ་བ, where it is the network of kin. Kept distinct from འཁོར = 'quyến thuộc', which is the next item in the same list. Flagged — see flags.

p0276, p0277, p0278, always paired with སྡུག་བསྔལ. Follows c046, which renders it 'ưu não' inside the list sầu muộn / than khóc / khổ đau / ưu não. c034 ('bất an nơi ý') and c057 ('ý bất an') are looser paraphrases in running prose; the paired technical use here takes the c046 form.
p0279, ཐར་པ་དོན་གཉེར་གྱི་བློ་སྣ་རྣལ་མ. Deliberately not the glossary's bare བློ = 'cái trí' (recorded as a GAP-specific provisional), since བློ་སྣ is an orientation of mind, not a cognition.

p0279 l.3 and l.5, in ཉེ་བར་ལེན་པའི་ཕུང་པོ་ལྔ་སྡུག་བསྔལ ("năm thủ uẩn là khổ"). No ruling exists; the standard Sino-Vietnamese 取蘊. Both the contracted and full Tibetan forms occur in this chunk and are rendered identically.

UNRESOLVED, flagged inline in the file rather than smoothed. p0278 l.3, ཚིགས་སུ་བཅད་པ་མེད་པ་སྟེ་གཏམ་ངན་པས་འཇིགས་པ. ཚིགས་སུ་བཅད་པ is "verse/kệ tụng" in all six other source/clean occurrences (p0073 x2, p0205, p0395, p0462, p0902), yet the gloss here is fear of ill report. Left literal with a tồn nghi note; needs a ruling on whether this is a source oddity, a corruption, or a lexical sense the project should register.
p0285 verse, bare form. The glossary has only the compound ལྷ་དབང་བརྒྱ་བྱིན = 'thiên chủ Đế Thích' (p0074); the bare name is rendered without 'thiên chủ' since the Tibetan here has no ལྷ་དབང.
p0285 verse. Established Sino-Vietnamese (轉輪王). No glossary entry existed.
p0285 verse, ཚངས་ཉིད་ཆགས་བྲལ་བདེ་བ. The glossary has only compounds (ཚངས་སྤྱོད, ཚངས་པའི་སྒྲ་དབྱངས); bare ཚངས་པ had none. See flag on ཚངས་ཉིད.
p0285-p0286, in the gloss on sun/moon light: the vimāna (support) vs. the devas dwelling in it (supported). Tibetan order རྟེན then བརྟེན་པ preserved as 'sở y' then 'năng y'.
p0285, the hell 'machines' of grinding/cutting. Rendered plainly rather than with a doctrinal term; the text itself treats them as devices located in three named hells.
p0284, juniper, in the earth-pellet simile. See flag on ཚི་གུ / ཚིག་གུ.
p0284, འཁོར་བའི་འབྲོག་དགོན་པ་ཆེན་པོ = 'hoang mạc lớn của luân hồi', in the Catuḥśataka commentary.

terms.vi: dòng sông Không Lội Qua Được
terms.note: p0285 verse. Variant wording of the glossary's ཆུ་ཀླུང་རབ་མེད (p0161-p0162); deliberately given the same Vietnamese so Phase 5 sees them as one name.

terms.vi: chốn rừng có lá tựa gươm đao
terms.note: p0285 verse. Verse-compressed variant of the glossary's ནགས་ཚལ་རལ་གྲི་ལོ་མ་ཅན = 'khu rừng có lá là gươm' (p0161-p0162); kept recognisably the same name.

p0286, the text's own gloss on རྣམ་གསུམ་མར་མེ: བསོད་ནམས་གསུམ = སྒོ་གསུམ་གྱི་དགེ་བ or the གཞི་གསུམ 'arising from giving etc.'. Rendered literally; the Tibetan here writes only གཞི་གསུམ, not the full title.

terms.vi: không có bạn đồng hành / phải đi [vào đó] mà không có bạn đồng hành
terms.note: RULING OWED. glossary.json pins bare གྲོགས = 'bạn hữu' (provisional) with an explicit note that bare གྲོགས must never be upgraded. c087 renders the negated form གྲོགས་མེད་པ (p0286, section label and the སྤྱོད་འཇུག lead-in) as 'không có bạn đồng hành'. 'đồng hành' carries no value-loading (it is not 'bạn lành' / thiện tri thức) and fits the fault being described — dying with no one accompanying you — but it is a second unregistered form of a deliberately pinned term. Kept as written; a ruling is needed on whether 'bạn đồng hành' is admissible for གྲོགས་མེད་པ, or whether the bare 'bạn hữu' must be used throughout ('không có bạn hữu').

terms.vi: nương tựa (trong hợp từ) / hầu hạ, hầu cận (thụ động, được phụng sự) / chịu lấy (phải gánh chịu)
terms.note: SENSE SPLIT. The glossary fixes བསྟེན་པ = 'nương tựa' only inside compounds (འདུ་ཤེས་དྲུག་བསྟེན་པ, བསྟེན་པའི་ཕན་ཡོན, བསམ་པས/སྦྱོར་བས་བསྟེན་པའི་ཚུལ). c087 has two further senses: (a) ལྷའི་བུ་མོས་བསྟེན་པ (p0285 commentary) → 'được các thiên nữ hầu hạ', passive, being attended on; (b) བསྟེན་འཚལ་ལོ twice in the Śiṣyalekha verse (རེག་པ་ཤིན་ཏུ་མི་བཟད་བསྟེན་འཚལ་ལོ; སྡུག་བསྔལ་རྒྱུན་མི་འཆད་པ་བསྟེན་འཚལ་ལོ) → 'ắt phải chịu lấy', undergoing/resorting-to torment. Both are correct for their sense and nothing was changed; three renderings of one verb in one chunk needs an explicit sense-split in the entry.

GAP. glossary.json has only compounds built on ཚངས་ (ཚངས་སྤྱོད, ཚངས་པར་སྤྱོད་པ, ཚངས་པའི་སྒྲ་དབྱངས, ཚངས་པ་མཚུངས་པར་སྤྱོད་པ); there is no entry for Brahmā/brahma-hood as such. p0285: ཚངས་ཉིད་ཆགས་བྲལ་བདེ་བ་ཐོབ་ནས་སླར → 'và an lạc ly tham của chính Phạm thiên'. ཉིད་ here is arguably the abstract-noun suffix (the STATE of being Brahmā, parallel to འཁོར་ལོས་བསྒྱུར་བ་ཉིད་དུ་གྱུར in the same verse), whereas 'chính Phạm thiên' reads as the person. A ruling should say which — 'quả vị Phạm thiên' / 'ngôi Phạm thiên' would carry the state reading. Wording kept unchanged pending that ruling.

GAP, and a POLICY CONFLICT to settle. p0285, same stanza as ཆུ་བོ་རབ་མེད་པ, as the heavenly river. Rendered descriptively (lower case, not as a name) while its hell counterpart two lines later was rendered as a capitalised proper name. Both are epithets in Tibetan and both are proper river names in the Indic source; one policy should govern both. Wording kept; the choice should be made centrally, not per chunk.

GAP. p0285: ལྷ་ཡུལ་འདོད་བདེ་ཤིན་ཏུ་ཆེན་པོ་དང་ → 'Đã đạt được dục lạc cực lớn nơi cõi trời'. Not registered. Distinguish from མཐོ་རིས = 'cõi cao' (already used in this chunk for མཐོ་རིས་བུ་མོ) so the two are not merged in Phase 5.

terms.vi: ngằn mé cuối cùng của [dòng] mẹ
terms.note: GAP. p0284, quoted twice — once in the verse (མ་ཡི་ཐུག་མཐའ་རྒྱ་ཤུག་ཚི་གུ་ཙམ) and once in Tsongkhapa's own argument (གཞུང་ལས་ཀྱང་མའི་ཐུག་མཐའ་ཞེས་གསུངས་པའི་ཕྱིར་རོ), so the two must stay word-identical; c087 keeps them identical. '[dòng]' is bracketed because 'chuỗi/dòng truyền' is supplied for Vietnamese to parse — the Tibetan has only མ. Register so the bracket and the wording are fixed for later citations.

terms.bo: མེ་མུར / རོ་མྱགས (dạng trần, không có འོབས / འདམ)
terms.vi: hố than hồng / vũng bùn xác rữa
terms.note: SCOPING NOTE, not a violation. The glossary registers only the full compounds མེ་མུར་གྱི་འོབས = 'hố than hồng' and རོ་མྱགས་ཀྱི་འདམ = 'vũng bùn xác rữa' (both p0161). The p0285 verse writes only the bare heads (སླར་ཡང་མེ་མུར་རོ་མྱགས་རྒྱུ་བ་ཡིས), so 'hố' and 'vũng bùn' are imported from the glossary rather than from this line. Same referents — the four neighbouring hells — so the wording is kept, but the entries should state that the bare heads take the full compound rendering, since the addition is invisible without checking the glossary.
p0194, Adhyāśayasaṃcodana verse: རྒྱགས་འདི་བག་མེད་ཀུན་གྱི་རྩ་བ་སྟེ. Kept deliberately distinct from ང་རྒྱལ and ཁེངས་པ, both of which glossary.json renders 'ngã mạn'. See flag.
p0194, the scrap of monastic robe Tönpa Rinpoche and Naljorpa Chenpo would not tread on. Rendered literally; the fact that it stands for the Saṅgha is left implicit, as in the Tibetan.

p0195, in the triad ལེ་ལོ་དང་སྙོམ་ལས་དང་བག་མེད་པ. Needs its own word because ལེ་ལོ is already fixed as 'biếng nhác' (glossary) and བག་མེད་པ as 'phóng dật'; the three occur side by side twice in this chunk (p0195, p0196–197).
p0194. Rendered by the two-member literal pair rather than flattened to 'thức ăn'.
p0194, བཟའ་བ་དང་བཅའ་བའི་ཕུད. Matches c062's wording for the same practice ('phần đầu của các thức ấy'), which is not registered either.
p0195, first of the ten offerings; glossed in the text as offering to the actual rūpakāya (གཟུགས་ཀྱི་སྐུ = sắc thân).

terms.vi: cúng dường hiện tiền / cúng dường chẳng hiện tiền
terms.note: p0195, third and fourth of the ten offerings; the contrast drives a long passage, plus a third combined form མངོན་དུ་གྱུར་མ་གྱུར་སྤྱིའི་མཆོད་པ = 'cúng dường chung cho cả [đối tượng] hiện tiền lẫn chẳng hiện tiền'.
p0196, eighth of the ten. Distinct from the glossary's བླ་ན་ཡོད་པའི་མཆོད་པ / བླ་ན་མེད་པའི་མཆོད་པ pair.

terms.vi: cúng dường không mang tạp nhiễm
terms.note: p0196–197, ninth of the ten. Built on the glossary's ཀུན་ནས་ཉོན་མོངས་པ = 'tạp nhiễm'.
p0197, the sixth aspect of the ninth offering, then defined negatively by a list of མི་མཐུན་པ items. See flag on the first item of that list.

p0197, cited with དཀོན་མཆོག་སྤྲིན as joint source. Built from components following c008's དམ་ཚིག་བཀོད་པའི་རྒྱལ་པོ = 'Đấng Tam-muội-da Trang Nghiêm Vương' (དམ་ཚིག = tam-muội-da, བཀོད་པ = trang nghiêm). No མདོ in the Tibetan, so no 'Kinh' prefix. See flag.
p0197, in the pratipatti-pūjā list. See flag — the identification with the four dharmoddāna is likely but not stated by the Tibetan wording, which has སྡོམ (summary), not ཕྱག་རྒྱ (seal).
p0196. Uses the glossary's ཡན་ལག = 'chi'; deliberately not the Sino-Vietnamese 'ngũ thể đầu địa', which the Tibetan does not say.

terms.vi: bố thí không bao giờ cạn
terms.note: p0196, ཞིང་ལ་སོགས་པ་ཟད་མི་ཤེས་པའི་སྦྱིན་པ. ཞིང here is farmland, rendered 'ruộng đất', consistent with the glossary's 'ruộng' for ཞིང.
p0196. Sanskrit coin name kept as the Tibetan itself transliterates it, with 'tiền' supplied so the Vietnamese parses.
p0197, in the list of unsuitable offering substances. Kept in Sanskrit, as the Tibetan transliterates.
p0197, same list. Kept in Sanskrit, as the Tibetan transliterates.
p0195, ཐམས་ཅད་ལ་མཆོད་པའི་འཕེན་པ་གཏོང་བ — sending forth the impetus of offering to all. Rendered by an idiomatic phrase since a literal 'buông ra sức phóng' is not Vietnamese.
p0197, paired with སེམས་དགའ་བ = 'tâm hoan hỷ'; the two needed distinct Vietnamese words in the same clause.

p0194 l.1, in the Ratnamegha/verse line དགེ་སློང་དམན་ལ་བརྙས་པར་ཡོང་མི་བྱ (c061 L16). No entry. glossary.json assigns "khinh miệt" to a DIFFERENT word, ཁྱད་གསོད, which is itself rendered "khinh miệt" at c061 L98 (p0196 l.9). Two distinct Tibetan words now share one Vietnamese inside one chunk. Wording kept - no ruling exists - but the pair needs splitting: e.g. བརྙས་པ = "khinh chê / miệt thị" against ཁྱད་གསོད = "khinh miệt", or the reverse. Whichever way it goes, decide once: both words recur.

Not a term ruling but a register ruling, and it is pervasive: c061 renders the fixed སངས་རྒྱས = "Phật" as "đức Phật" seven times in prose (L54, L56, L60, L61, L70, L90, L101) and དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ = "Như Lai" as "đức Như Lai" (L110), while the Samādhirāja verse at L43 correctly has bare "Phật". The fixed word is intact and "đức" is standard Vietnamese Buddhist register, so the text is kept - but nothing in the glossary licenses the prefix, and Phase 5's consistency sweep will read every instance as drift. A ruling should state: prefix permitted in prose, forbidden inside quoted verse (or whatever is decided), once for the whole book. Note the contrasting case settled in this repair: "đức" WAS removed from the personal name སྟོན་པ་རིན་པོ་ཆེ, whose Tibetan honorific is already inside the transcription.

p0195 l.1, ཐམས་ཅད་ལ་མཆོད་པའི་འཕེན་པ་གཏོང་བ - the mental thrust/projection of offering that is 'sent forth' (གཏོང་བ) toward all buddhas and stūpas once dharmatā is recalled as indivisible. All four existing འཕེན་པ entries are karma-context (ākṣepakakarman, paired with རྫོགས་བྱེད); this is a different sense in a different section. The glossary's "dẫn phát" has been applied rather than the previous interpretive "ý hướng", but the entry should record this second, non-karma use explicitly so it is not later read as a stray of dẫn nghiệp - and should confirm or replace "buông ra" for གཏོང་བ in this idiom.

p0195 l.3 and p0197 l.1, both in རང་གིས་ལག་བདར་ནས་བྱེད་པ - doing the offering having extended one's own hand, opposed to གཞན་བྱེད་དུ་འཇུག་པ. No entry. New wording introduced by this repair (replacing "tự tay mình ra sức mà làm", which added an intensifier). Occurs twice in this chunk alone and defines two of the ten offerings, so it should be fixed before it recurs.

p0196 l.5, one of the acts of བཀུར་སྟི in the offering list, between ཕྱག་འཚལ་བ and ཐལ་མོ་སྦྱར་བ. No entry. New wording introduced by this repair (replacing "đứng dậy nghênh đón", which added an act of going out to greet). The bracketed [ngài] supplies what མངོན་དུ implies without naming; a ruling should confirm that or pick a settled Sino-Vietnamese form.

p0229, first of the six modes of weight taught in the Bổn Địa Phần (Maulī Bhūmi). Coined from the components (མངོན་པར = abhi-, འདུ་བྱེད་པ = saṃskāra = hành). Deliberately NOT 'gia hành', although the Chinese for this Yogācārabhūmi item is 加行: སྦྱོར་བ is already pinned as 'gia hành' in the fourfold karmapatha frame that runs through this very chapter, so reusing it would collapse two distinct terms. Needs a ruling.

p0229, in the fifth and sixth of the six modes of weight (མི་མཐུན་པའི་ཕྱོགས་གཅིག་ཏུ་ངེས་པ, མི་མཐུན་ཕྱོགས་སེལ་བ). Kept distinct from the glossary's གཉེན་པོ = 'đối trị', which is its counterpart and occurs in the Suhṛllekha verse on the same page (གཉེན་པོ་མེད = 'không có đối trị'). Recurs at p0351, p0451, p0491, p0539.

p0231. Rendered from the components, which map onto the established Sino-Vietnamese title 信力入印法門經 (Tín Lực Nhập Ấn Pháp Môn); 'Pháp Môn' dropped because the Tibetan has no corresponding word. NOT verified against an existing Vietnamese edition.

terms.vi: Kinh Nhập Định Bất Định Ấn
terms.note: p0231. Established Sino-Vietnamese title 入定不定印經; the components match the Tibetan one for one (ངེས་པ = định, མ་ངེས་པ = bất định, ལ་འཇུག་པ = nhập, ཕྱག་རྒྱ = ấn). NOT verified against an existing Vietnamese edition.

terms.vi: Kinh Tịch Tĩnh Quyết Định Thần Biến
terms.note: p0231 (citation runs into p0232); the same title recurs at p0416. Rendered from the components (རབ་ཏུ་ཞི་བ = tịch tĩnh, following the glossary's ཞི་བ = tịch tĩnh; རྣམ་པར་ངེས་པ = quyết định; ཆོ་འཕྲུལ = thần biến). The received Chinese title is 寂照神變三摩地經 ('Tịch Chiếu Thần Biến Tam-ma-địa'), whose 照 does not answer to རྣམ་པར་ངེས་པ — see flag. NOT verified.
p0231, འཁོར་སྒྱུར་རམ་ཚངས་པའི་བདེ་བ. Contracted form of འཁོར་ལོས་སྒྱུར་བ; no glossary entry exists for either spelling.
p0231, the deity sense, paired with འཁོར་སྒྱུར. Glossary has only the compounds ཚངས་པར་སྤྱོད་པ = phạm hạnh and ཚངས་པའི་སྒྲ་དབྱངས = Phạm âm; the bare deity name had no entry.

p0229 (paired with བསོད་ནམས) and p0230. The glossary registers only compounds (ཁ་ན་མ་ཐོ་བ་མེད་པ, རང་བཞིན་དང་བཅས་པའི་ཁ་ན་མ་ཐོ་བ); the bare term had no entry. Follows c067's rendering at p0213 so the two do not read as different terms.

terms.vi: bậc đã đi đến chân chánh
terms.note: p0228, in the mithyādṛṣṭi formula འཇིག་རྟེན་ན་དགྲ་བཅོམ་པ་དང་ཡང་དག་པར་སོང་བ་དང་ཡང་དག་པར་ཞུགས་པ་དག་མེད. Rendered literally rather than with the conventional 'chánh hướng', which would import a technical label the Tibetan does not carry.

terms.vi: bậc đã bước vào chân chánh
terms.note: p0228, same formula as ཡང་དག་པར་སོང་བ. Rendered literally rather than 'chánh hạnh'.

p0231, དང་བས་བལྟ་བ = 'nhìn với tâm tịnh tín'. Follows the glossary's རབ་དང་བ = tịnh tín, and stays distinct from དད་པ = lòng tin and མོས་པ = lòng tin ưa, both of which occur nearby (ཐེག་ཆེན་ལ་མོས་པའི་བྱང་སེམས in the same sentence).
p0230, Sūryagarbha verse. ཐུ་ལུམ = a lump/ball; no glossary entry.
p0231, Sūryagarbha verse (མེ་མདག་དག་གིས་གང་བ་ཡི་གནས་ཁང). Live coals/embers; no glossary entry.
p0230, ཚུལ་འཆལ་གྱིས་སྤྱད་ན. No glossary entry; kept distinct from the glossary's ཚུལ་ཁྲིམས = giới.

p0229 l.1, third of the six modes of heaviness. No entry in glossary.json. Wording KEPT. Here it is the intrinsic nature of the act itself (the earlier of the seven bodily/verbal acts is heavier than the later), not the Madhyamaka sense; the ruling should say whether the same Vietnamese is used in both contexts.

terms.vi: cửa [tài vật] được gom vào để thọ dụng
terms.note: p0230 l.1, twice, inside the Smṛtyupasthāna quotation (གལ་ཏེ་ཞལ་དུ་འདུ་བའི་སྒོ་ཞིག་ན / གལ་ཏེ་ཞལ་དུ་འདུ་བའི་སྒོ་མ་ཡིན་ན). No entry. Wording KEPT. The honorific ཞལ་ is literally 'mouth', i.e. what is gathered in for eating; c071 generalises it to 'thọ dụng' (consumption/use of any kind). A ruling should decide whether the food-specific sense is kept, since the distinction is what separates the two hell-destinations in the passage.
p0329. The Tibetan is a bare Sanskrit transliteration, so it is left in Sanskrit. No honorific added — the source has none, and no work title is named.

terms.vi: Thí Dụ về Bảy Đồng Nữ
terms.note: p0330. Built on the existing provisional རྟོགས་པ་བརྗོད་པ = thí dụ and the pattern already used for དགེ་འདུན་སྲུངས་ཀྱི་རྟོགས་པ་བརྗོད་པ = 'Thí Dụ về Saṅgharakṣita'. གཞོན་ནུ་མ is feminine, hence đồng nữ (contrast གཞོན་ནུ = đồng tử in the glossary's Sudhana entries).

terms.vi: khí thế gian và hữu tình thế gian
terms.note: p0330, སྣོད་བཅུད་ཀྱི་འཁོར་བ. སྣོད = 'khí thế gian' is already corpus usage (c073 l.22, l.56); བཅུད rendered 'hữu tình thế gian' rather than absorbing it into 'chúng sinh', so the container/contents pair stays visible.

p0330, inside the Saptakumārikā verse (དུར་ཁྲོད་དག་ཏུ་མཆི). No corpus precedent existed. Sino-Vietnamese 尸林 chosen over the colloquial 'bãi tha ma' to keep the register of the verse; flagging in case the project prefers the plainer form.

p0330, the simile that names the whole passage. བྱང is the northern region (Jangthang); rendered 'miền Bắc' rather than transliterated 'Jang' because the text's own gloss immediately says བྱང་ན་རྩམ་པ་དཀོན་པས — 'in the north tsampa is scarce' — and reads as a place-description there.
p0330, three times in the simile. Left in transcription; no Vietnamese equivalent exists for roasted barley flour and a descriptive rendering would swamp the story.
p0330, five times. ཉུང་གཤེར = 'củ cải tươi', ཉུང་མ་སྐམ་པོ = 'củ cải khô', ཉུང་མ་བཙོས་འཁེངས = 'củ cải luộc chín'. ཉུང་མ་ཕོ་ཤ left untranslated — see flag.

terms.vi: hý luận / hoàn toàn không hý luận
terms.note: p0329 l.1, inside the Caryāmelāpakapradīpa citation, `ཤིན་ཏུ་སྤྲོས་པ་མེད་པའི་སྤྱོད་པ`. No entry, and the word occurs nowhere in the translated corpus yet. In tantric caryā context this is the third of the three conducts (སྤྲོས་བཅས / སྤྲོས་མེད / ཤིན་ཏུ་སྤྲོས་མེད), so a ruling should cover the whole three-member set before the mantra sections are reached. Rendered literally; no doctrinal expansion supplied.

p0329 l.1, `དང་པོ་ཁོ་ནར་སྒྲུབ་པ་པོས`. No entry. Note glossary.json renders `སྒྲུབ་པ` as "tu tập" inside `སྒྲུབ་པའི་ཆོས`, and a separate open question already exists over `སྒྲུབ་པའི་མཆོད་པ` = "tu hành"; "hành giả" is a third form of the same element, so the three should be ruled on together. Also needs separating from `རྣལ་འབྱོར་པ`, which the corpus renders "hành giả du-già" (c006, c034).

p0329 l.1, `ཐེག་པ་ཆེན་པོའི་ཚུལ་གྱི་གཟིངས་ཀྱིས་བསྒྲལ་བར་བྱ་བའི་ཕྱིར`. No entry. "chiếc thuyền" matches the corpus's existing rendering of the boat image (c022, c037, c079, c080), but those all render `གྲུ`, not `གཟིངས` — register whether the two Tibetan words are to be kept distinct (e.g. thuyền / bè) or deliberately collapsed.

p0329 l.1, closing the Candrakīrti citation. Built on the existing provisional ruling that the verbal use of `བཟོད་པ` may take "kham" (recorded at p0223 for the negated `མི་བཟོད་པ`); this is the affirmative verbal use, "to bear / accept being offered to", and is distinct from the fixed `བཟོད་པ` = nhẫn (the pāramitā). Register so the affirmative form is covered too.

p0329 l.1, `ཚུལ་དེ་ནི་གསང་སྔགས་བླ་ན་མེད་པ་ལ་ཡང་དགོས་ཏེ`. Built from the provisional `གསང་སྔགས` = "Mật chú" plus `བླ་ན་མེད་པ` = "vô thượng". Needs registering alongside the existing `རྣལ་འབྱོར་བླ་ན་མེད་པ` = "Vô Thượng Du-già" so the two anuttara compounds stay distinguishable.

terms.vi: sự tự tại của vương vị
terms.note: p0329 l.1, `ཐ་ན་རྒྱལ་སྲིད་ཀྱི་དབང་ཕྱུག་ལ་ཡང`. Neither `རྒྱལ་སྲིད` nor this compound has an entry. `དབང་ཕྱུག` = "tự tại" follows the existing `དབང་ཕྱུག་ཕུན་སུམ་ཚོགས་པ` = "tự tại viên mãn"; the entry should note that this is the ordinary-noun sense and must NOT take the glossary's `དབང་ཕྱུག` = "Tự Tại Thiên" (Īśvara) or "Thế Tự Tại".

p0330 l.1, `སྣོད་བཅུད་ཀྱི་འཁོར་བ`, rendered as the pair "khí thế gian lẫn hữu tình thế gian". glossary.json has `སྣོད་ཀྱི་འཇིག་རྟེན` = "khí thế gian" but no counterpart for the `བཅུད` half. Register the pair together, and cover the contracted form `སྣོད་བཅུད` which is what the source actually prints here.
p0330 l.1, `སྡུག་བསྔལ་གསུམ་གྱི་མེ`. No entry. Uses the fixed `སྡུག་བསྔལ` = khổ. Listed only so the numbered set gets registered before the section that enumerates the three.
p0330 l.1, `ཐར་པ་ལ་མངོན་པར་དགའ་བའི་ཐོབ་འདོད་འབྱུང་ངོ`. No entry. Rendering unobjectionable; listed for registration.

p0303–p0304, three times: འཕེན་བྱེད་ཀྱི་ལས་རང་དགའ་བ, ཀུན་འབྱུང་གི་བདེན་པ་རང་དགའ་བ་དངོས, ཀུན་འབྱུང་རང་དགའ་བར་འགྲོ་བ. No glossary entry. Scholastic qualifier contrasted with དངོས / རྗེས་སུ་མཐུན་པ: the thing 'in its own right, unqualified' as against what merely accords with it. Rendered 'thuần túy' in all three so the contrast stays visible. See flag — the reading is not certain.

p0303–p0304, three times (twice inside the Nhiếp Quyết Trạch quotation). Bare ཀུན་འབྱུང is kept as 'tập khởi' following c090's heading and c082; the compound with བདེན་པ takes the standard 'tập đế'. Registered so the two are not read as drift. The glossary's བདེན་པ entry already asks for a ruling.

p0303. Here འཕེན་བྱེད qualifies བདེན་པ, not ལས, so the glossary's noun འཕེན་བྱེད = 'dẫn nghiệp' would not parse; rendered 'năng dẫn' adjectivally. The separate འཕེན་བྱེད་ཀྱི་ལས in the same paragraph is kept as 'dẫn nghiệp' per glossary.

p0303–p0304, three times inside the Nhiếp Quyết Trạch quotation (ཡང་འབྱུང་བའི་སྲེད་པ / ཡང་འབྱུང་བའི་སྲིད་པ / ཡང་འབྱུང་བའི་ལུས་ངག་ཡིད). Kept as a transparent phrase rather than 'tái hữu' so it stays distinct from ཡང་སྲིད in the surrounding commentary.

p0303, ཡང་སྲིད་ཕྱི་མ་བསྐྱེད་པའི་ཀུན་འབྱུང = 'tập khởi vốn sinh ra tái hữu đời sau'. Compact Sino-Vietnamese used here because the commentary voice is dense; the quotation's ཡང་འབྱུང་བ is kept descriptive so the two Tibetan words remain separable.
p0303, twice. Built on the fixed བསོད་ནམས = phúc đức and ལས = nghiệp; house style 'phúc', not 'phước'. c042 already has 'phi phúc' in a verse.
p0303. The middle member of the བསོད་ནམས་མ་ཡིན་པ / བསོད་ནམས / མི་གཡོ་བ triad; the three should be fixed together.
p0303. Third member of the triad. Established Sino-Vietnamese (不動業).
p0303, ཚོགས་ལམ་པ. No entry. Built on the corpus's established ཚོགས = 'tư lương' and capitalised to match c005/c007's 'Gia Hành đạo'.
p0303, སྦྱོར་ལམ་པ. Not registered although c005 and c007 already use 'Gia Hành đạo'. Recorded here so the pair with ཚོགས་ལམ is fixed.
p0304, twice, naming the first of the two-fold division of karma-accumulation. ཚོར་བ has no glossary entry at all; 'thọ' is assumed here inside the compound.
p0304. No entry. Rendered literally (ཁ་ཕྱིར་བལྟ = outward-facing) rather than with 'ngoại cảnh', so the contrast with ཏིང་ངེ་འཛིན་ལས་སྐྱེས་པའི་བདེ་བ stays in the wording.
p0303, འདོད་ཁམས་ཀྱི་དགེ་བ. No entry for the bare term; matches c082's 'Dục giới'.

terms.vi: phúc nghiệp / phi phúc nghiệp / bất động nghiệp
terms.note: བསོད་ནམས is status 'fixed' = 'phúc đức', but inside this karma triad the established corpus form contracts it to bare 'phúc' (c094 l.11-12, l.58; c093 l.59; c095 l.11-16; c097 l.71-82). Wording kept. A scoped entry is owed so a Phase 5 sweep does not read the contraction as drift from the fixed 'phúc đức'.

The existing entry gives the noun འཕེན་བྱེད = 'dẫn nghiệp' and the verb འཕེན་པ = 'dẫn phát', but rules nothing for the attributive use. c094 l.25 has 'tập đế năng dẫn'; this is NOT unlicensed drift — 'năng dẫn' is already the settled corpus attributive form (c098 l.34-35, l.41, l.49, l.54, l.60, l.65; c099 l.17, l.29-30, all rendering འཕེན་བྱེད་ཀྱི་ཡན་ལག as 'chi năng dẫn'). Wording kept; register 'năng dẫn' as the attributive form of the same entry.

No entry for the bare form; the glossary registers only རྣམ་པར་སུན་འབྱིན་པ = 'sự phá trừ hoàn toàn'. Text has been aligned to 'phá trừ' at c094 l.31 and l.44 (the corpus-unique 'phá bác' is gone), but a ruling on the bare form is still owed so the choice is settled centrally rather than re-decided.

terms.vi: Tư Lương đạo / Gia Hành đạo
terms.note: Neither has an entry; c094 l.21 appears to be the first ཚོགས་ལམ occurrence in the corpus. Wording kept. Note pre-existing casing drift this chunk extends rather than introduces: c093 l.99 has lowercase 'gia hành đạo' against c005/c007's capitalised 'Gia Hành đạo'. One ruling plus a casing sweep is owed. (Related: two existing notes already reference 'Gia Hành đạo (སྦྱོར་ལམ) already used in c005' as a collision to avoid, so the term is assumed settled without ever being registered.)
p0300. The first of the two-fold division of karma to be accumulated. Built on the glossary's སེམས་པ = tư (provisional) plus ལས = nghiệp (fixed); 思業, the established Sino-Vietnamese.
p0300, the counterpart of སེམས་པའི་ལས. 思已業. Must be fixed together with tư nghiệp — the pair names the whole subsection.
p0300-p0301, in the Abhidharmasamuccaya definition of cetanā and in the Kośa verse.
p0301. Rendered analytically ('nghiệp thân ngữ' in running prose) rather than as a compound, because the text repeatedly separates ལུས and ངག.
p0301, in the Vaibhāṣika division of bodily/verbal karma. 表業. In running prose rendered 'biểu nghiệp' where ལས is understood.
p0301. 無表業. The mirror of རིག་བྱེད; the two must stay a visible pair.

p0301. No glossary entry. Kept distinct from the glossary's བྱེ་བྲག་ཏུ = riêng biệt and from c005's title *Đại Tỳ-bà-sa* (བྱེ་བྲག་བཤད་མཛོད་ཆེན་མོ). 'Hữu bộ' was avoided because the Tibetan names the Vaibhāṣikas, not the Sarvāstivāda.
p0301. Already used in c082 but never registered. Note the glossary's ཟག་པ = 'sai phạm' entry is a DIFFERENT sense (p0129, monastic transgression) and must not collide with this one.
p0301, paired with ཟག་བཅས in the same sentence.
p0301, also in the contracted verse form འདོད་ཁམས. No glossary entry; the existing ཁམས་གོང་མ་གཉིས = 'hai giới trên' entry presupposes it.
p0301, in གཟུགས་དང་གཟུགས་མེད་ཀྱི་ས. 'giới' was NOT added: the Tibetan says ས (địa/bhūmi), not ཁམས. Follows the precedent of the glossary's ཁམས་གོང་མ་གཉིས note.

p0302, quoting MMK XXVI.10. 'Căn Bản' renders རྩ་བ, which distinguishes the root text from the glossary's དབུ་མ་ལ་འཇུག་པ = *Nhập Trung Luận* and དབུ་མའི་སྙིང་པོ = *Trung Quán Tâm Luận*. If the project prefers the bare established Vietnamese title, it is *Trung Luận*.
p0302, twice, always paired with ཕྱིར་འོང.
p0302. The short spelling (not ཕྱིར་འོང་བ). Must be fixed together with རྒྱུན་ཞུགས.
p0301, p0302. Spelling variant of the glossary's སོ་སོའི་སྐྱེ་བོ = phàm phu; same Vietnamese used. Recorded so a consistency sweep does not treat the two spellings as different terms.

terms.vi: vô minh mang tánh phiền não
terms.note: p0302, last line. Built on c091's rendering of ཉོན་མོངས་ཅན་གྱི་ཤེས་རབ as 'trí tuệ mang tánh phiền não', so the ཉོན་མོངས་ཅན་གྱི་ construction stays uniform.
p0302. The contracted spelling of འཇིག་ཚོགས་ལ་ལྟ་བ; rendered exactly as c091 renders the full form.

p0302. The glossary rules གང་ཟག = 'hạng người' with an explicit note that the choice was made because that passage was enumerative, not technical. Here it IS technical (pudgala-ātman as against dharma-ātman), so the transcription was used. A ruling is needed on the split.

p0302, ཐེག་ཆེན་གྱི་སྦྱོར་ལམ་ཆོས་མཆོག་ཆེན་པོ. The familiar Sino-Vietnamese is 世第一法 = 'thế đệ nhất pháp', but that renders འཇིག་རྟེན་པའི་ཆོས་མཆོག; this Tibetan has no འཇིག་རྟེན་པ, so 'thế' was not supplied. See flag.
p0302, the standard contraction of ལས་དང་ཉོན་མོངས. Expanded in Vietnamese; no compound coined.

p0302, མཁས་རྣམས / མི་མཁས / མཁས་མིན in MMK XXVI.10. The glossary has མཁས་པ = 'bậc học giả', which is wrong register here — the verse contrasts one who sees suchness with one who does not, not a scholar with a layman. See flag.

p0301. Compound has no entry; only bare བསོད་ནམས = phúc đức (fixed) exists. Wording KEPT, not changed: `phúc nghiệp` / `phi phúc nghiệp` is already the corpus form in c094 (x3), c095 and c097 (x3), and it is what makes the three-member set legible beside མི་གཡོ་བའི་ལས = `bất động nghiệp`. Rewriting it as `nghiệp phúc đức` in c093 alone would break four chunks and the triad. Needs a compound ruling so a Phase 5 sweep on the fixed headword does not flag all of them. Bare བསོད་ནམས in this chunk's Kośa verse was changed to `phúc đức`.

p0301, the Vaibhāṣika division of body-and-speech karma. No ruling. The internal split within the paragraph is now removed (the second occurrence's `biểu nghiệp` was reduced to `biểu`, since the Tibetan there has no ལས). Register `biểu` / `vô biểu` as the form; sole occurrence in the corpus so far.

p0301, ཟག་བཅས་ཟག་མེད་གཉིས and ཟག་པ་དང་བཅས་པའི་ལས. glossary.json's only ཟག་པ entry rules it `sai phạm` for a vow-infraction list (p0129) and explicitly reserves the āsrava sense, so this is a gap and not a departure. Kept.

p0300, inside the Gönpawa quotation as one of four nouns to be known (ཉེས་དམིགས / མཚན་ཉིད / གཉེན་པོ / སྐྱེ་བའི་རྒྱུ). The registered form `đối trị` is verbal in Vietnamese and does not stand as a list item; `pháp đối trị` is the nominal. Text KEPT — see `remaining`. Needs the nominal variant licensed on the existing entry, not a new headword.
Section heading s114. Built on the glossary's ཡན་ལག = 'chi' (provisional, kept bare so the twelve stay countable) and མདོར་བསྡུ་བ = 'tóm lược'.

Abhidharmasamuccaya's fourfold grouping of the twelve links (p0317-p0318). Glossary has འཕེན་བྱེད = 'dẫn nghiệp' and the verb འཕེན་པ = 'dẫn phát' (c073/c074), but those were fixed for the འཕེན་རྫོགས karma classification, where the counterpart is རྫོགས་བྱེད. Here the counterpart is འགྲུབ་བྱེད, so 'dẫn nghiệp' does not fit and the standard 能引/所引 pair was used. The verb is still rendered 'dẫn phát', matching the glossary.
Counterpart of འཕེན་པའི་ཡན་ལག. The verbal form འཕངས་པ is rendered 'được dẫn phát', per the glossary's འཕེན་པ entry.

Third of the four. Rendered from the Tibetan verb འགྲུབ་པར་བྱེད་པ ('làm cho thành tựu'); མངོན་པར is not given a separate word. NOT the conventional Sino-Vietnamese 'chi năng sinh' (能生支, Xuanzang's rendering of the same Abhidharmasamuccaya passage), because the Tibetan does not say སྐྱེད་པ. See flags. The paired nouns འགྲུབ་བྱེད / གྲུབ་པ later in the chunk follow as 'năng thành' / 'sở thành'.
Fourth of the four; counterpart of the above. Conventional Sino-Vietnamese would be 'chi sở sinh' (所生支) — see flags.
p0317, first of the four upādāna. ལེན་པ (the link) = 'thủ'; ཉེ་བར་ལེན་པ is not separately rendered 'cận thủ' — the established Sino-Vietnamese set names were used.
Second of the four. Built on the glossary's ལྟ་བ = 'kiến' (provisional).

Third of the four. The Tibetan spells out ཚུལ་ཁྲིམས (giới, fixed) + བརྟུལ་ཞུགས (cấm hạnh, provisional); the compact established form 戒禁取 was used for the set name, while the object it grasps is rendered fully as 'giới và cấm hạnh xấu ác' two lines earlier.
Fourth of the four. བདག་ཏུ་སྨྲ་བ = 'ngã ngữ' (我語).
The ninth link. No glossary entry; distinct from the glossary's ཁས་ལེན་པ and སྙིང་པོ་ལེན་པ entries, which use ལེན་པ in other senses.
The third link. No glossary entry. Its two temporal forms in this chunk: རྒྱུ་དུས་ཀྱི་རྣམ་ཤེས = 'thức thời nhân', འབྲས་དུས་ཀྱི་རྣམ་ཤེས = 'thức thời quả'.
The fifth link. Rendered from སྐྱེ་མཆེད = xứ (āyatana) rather than the alternative Sino-Vietnamese 'lục nhập', so the count stays visible.
The sixth link. Distinct from the glossary's བདེ་བ་ལ་རེག་པར་གནས་པ, where རེག་པ is 'sự tiếp xúc' in an ordinary sense.
The twelfth link, defined on p0317: རྒ་བ = 'lão', ཤི་བ = 'tử'.
p0317, in the definition of death: ཕུང་པོའི་རིས་མཐུན་དོར་བ = 'xả bỏ đồng phần của các uẩn'. Established Sino-Vietnamese 同分.

p0318-p0319. ཚར = a single round/run of the twelve-link sequence; also ཚར་གཅིག / ཚར་གཉིས = 'một lượt / hai lượt'. Kept distinct from རྒྱུ་འབྲས་སྐོར = 'vòng nhân quả', which the same passage uses alongside it.
p0318-p0319, སྐོར་སྔ་མ / སྐོར་ཕྱི་མ = 'vòng trước' / 'vòng sau'. Distinct from ཆོས་སྐོར = 'phần giáo pháp' in the glossary.

p0320, cited for the view that only སྐྱེ་བ is the actualized limb. Built from the Tibetan components on the glossary's རྟེན་ཅིང་འབྲེལ་པར་འབྱུང་བ = 'duyên khởi'; མདོ་འགྲེལ = 'kinh thích' (commentary on the sūtra). Not verified against an existing Vietnamese edition, and the Tibetan does not name an author.
p0320, last sentence of the chunk. Established Sino-Vietnamese title 稻稈經. The source spells ལང་པ where the usual Tibetan is ལྗང་པ (sprout) — see flags. First occurrence in the corpus.
p0320. Built on the glossary's བསོད་ནམས = 'phúc đức' (fixed, northern register) plus འདུ་བྱེད = 'hành'; the compact 福行 form used because it names a member of the standard triad.
p0320, the counterpart of བསོད་ནམས་ཀྱི་འདུ་བྱེད in the same sentence. Established Sino-Vietnamese 不動行.
p0320, ཉོན་མོངས་པ་དང་ལས་དང་སྡུག་བསྔལ་གྱི་ལམ་གསུམ = 'ba đạo: phiền não, nghiệp và khổ'. ལམ rendered 'đạo' literally; the Tibetan does not use the Chinese tradition's 惑 for the first member.

p0317 l.3, གཟུགས་སྒྲ་ལ་སོགས་པའི་འདོད་ཡོན → 'các diệu dục'. Text KEPT. No entry exists for bare འདོད་ཡོན; glossary.json registers only འདོད་ཡོན་ལྔ = 'năm dục lạc' (provisional, p0223). 'diệu dục' and 'dục lạc' share no substring, so the two will float apart across the karma and twelve-links chapters. A ruling is owed on the base term AND on whether འདོད་ཡོན་ལྔ should be brought into line with it ('năm diệu dục').

Third nidāna; both the full and contracted Tibetan forms occur (p0317–p0320) and both are rendered 'thức'. Also in the compounds རྒྱུ་དུས་ཀྱི་རྣམ་ཤེས = 'thức thời nhân' and འབྲས་དུས་ཀྱི་རྣམ་ཤེས = 'thức thời quả'. Registration owed.

Fourth nidāna, p0318 (ཀུན་ལས་བཏུས citation). Rendered as the two members joined, following the Tibetan's དང. Registration owed; a ruling should also say whether the compact 'danh sắc' is preferred where the Tibetan has no དང.
Ninth nidāna, p0317 l.3 and p0318–p0319. Both the short and the ཉེ་བར- form are rendered 'thủ'. Registration owed.
p0317 l.7, in the definition of སྐྱེ་བ. Conventional Sino-Vietnamese; compatible with the fixed སྐྱེ་བ = 'sinh' and with house-style northern 'sinh'. Registration owed.

terms.vi: Cách thức chết chuyển và kết sinh
terms.note: Section heading s111 (path 6.2.3.1.4.2.1.2.3), p0305. NOT new wording: translation/c090.md l.70 already announces this section as 'cách thức chết chuyển cùng kết sinh'; adopted verbatim except 'cùng' -> 'và'. Components: འཆི་འཕོ་བ = 'chết chuyển' (c066 l.20 already has 'chết chuyển đi' for འཆི་འཕོས); ཉིང་མཚམས་སྦྱོར = 'kết sinh' (c082, c087, c088).

p0307-p0308, the pivot term of subsections 4-5 of this section. Chosen as 中有 rather than the popular 'trung ấm' so it pairs with the glossary's སྲིད་པ = 'hữu' and with སྐྱེ་སྲིད = 'sinh hữu' in the same sentence-run. No occurrence of either form anywhere in translation/ yet, so nothing constrains it — but c096 continues this same section and must match.
p0306, fifth subdivision (དེ་ནས་སྐྱེ་སྲིད་དུ་སྐྱེ་བ་ལེན་ཚུལ). Built on the glossary's སྲིད་པ = hữu, deliberately parallel to བར་དོ = 'trung hữu' so the 有 series stays visible.

p0306, third cause of death: ཡ༌ང་བ་མ་སྤངས་པས་འཆི་བ = 'chết do không đoạn trừ điều nguy hiểm'. See flag: read as ཡ་ང་བ (dreadful / perilous), the non-breaking tsheg being the source's ordinary device (it writes དང༌། 1534× the same way), NOT as a corruption of ཉམ་ང་བ, which the corpus spells correctly at p0236/p0274/p0278/p0339/p0352/p0690. Sole occurrence in the book.

p0306 (×1) and p0307 (×2), the mild/severe contrast and the statement that it is absent for gods and hell-beings. Rendered descriptively from the Tibetan components (གནད = chỗ hiểm/yếu huyệt, གཅོད = cắt đứt) rather than with the transliterated Abhidharma term 'đoạn mạt-ma' (斷末摩), since the Tibetan itself translates rather than transliterates. Needs a ruling if 'đoạn mạt-ma' is preferred house style.
p0305, བསམ་གཏན་བཞི་པ་ནས་སྲིད་རྩེའི་བར་དུ. Established Sino-Vietnamese 有頂, and consistent with the glossary's སྲིད་པ = hữu.

terms.vi: bậc Dự lưu / bậc Nhất lai / bậc Bất hoàn
terms.note: p0307. 'bậc Dự lưu' and 'bậc Nhất lai' already occur in translation/c093.md (tail) for the same pair in a parallel argument, including the same simile (mi stobs ldan gyis stobs chung ngu brdung ba = 'người có sức mạnh đánh gục kẻ yếu sức'); ཕྱིར་མི་འོང = 'bậc Bất hoàn' is fixed here for the first time on the same Sino-Vietnamese pattern (不還).

p0308, སྔོན་སྤྲོས་པ་ལ་དགའ་བས་ཡོངས་སུ་བསྒོས་པ = 'sự huân tập trọn vẹn bởi niềm ưa thích đối với hí luận thuở trước'. Established Sino-Vietnamese 戲論. First occurrence in the translated corpus; the term will recur heavily in the last two divisions, so it should be settled centrally.
p0306-p0307, ལས་ཀྱི་འབྲས་བུའི་སྔ་ལྟས་རྣམས. Rendered plainly rather than 'tiền triệu'.

terms.vi: hai đầu cán cân bên cao bên thấp
terms.note: p0308, the standard simile for the simultaneity of death and the arising of the intermediate state. Rendered descriptively; སྲང་མདའ = cán cân (beam of a balance).
p0308, six occurrences in the section on where the warmth withdraws. Bare 'thức'; no entry exists for རྣམ་ཤེས or རྣམ་པར་ཤེས་པ in glossary.json, which is a surprising gap this early in the book.
p0306-p0308, the criterion that decides whether the dying mind is virtuous, non-virtuous or neutral. Built on the glossary's འདུ་ཤེས = tưởng.
p0306, ninth of the nine causes of untimely death.

terms.vi: huân tập ('sự huân tập trọn vẹn')
terms.kind: new sense — needs its own entry
terms.note: p0308 l.5, སྔོན་སྤྲོས་པ་ལ་དགའ་བས་ཡོངས་སུ་བསྒོས་པ. This is the 'perfuming' sense, NOT the existing entry བསྒོ་བ = 'lời dặn bảo' (p0244, 'to instruct'), which is a homograph. Requesting a separate entry so the two senses do not merge, and so that 'huân tập' stays reserved for this term and is never reused for གོམས་པ.

p0306 l.3 and p0307 l.1 (གཟུགས་མི་སྡུག་པ... / རྨི་ལམ་བཞིན་དུ་གཟུགས་མི་སྡུག་པ་དུ་མ), rendered 'sắc tướng' at l.50 and l.58. No entry exists for གཟུགས, so the wording is kept per the gap rule — but it overlaps the recorded མཚན་མ = 'tướng' (which the chunk uses correctly at l.61, མཚན་མ་མི་སྡུག་པ). One ruling should keep them apart; the obvious split is གཟུགས = 'sắc' / 'hình sắc' and མཚན་མ = 'tướng'.
p0305 l.3, l.5. Half of the section headword འཆི་འཕོ་བ་དང་ཉིང་མཚམས་སྦྱོར་ཚུལ, so it recurs in the outline.
p0305 l.1, ཚོར་བ་བཏང་སྙོམས་པའི་དོན་དུ — the neutral feeling, not the immeasurable.
p0305 l.5 and p0308 l.3, དྲོད་གང་ནས་སྡུད་པ — a sub-section headword, so it needs to be stable.
p0305 l.7, ཡ་ང་བ་མ་སྤངས་པས་འཆི་བ — the third of the three causes of death. Rendered descriptively.
p0308 l.3, four times. Anatomical/subtle-body locus of the consciousness's departure; 'tim' chosen over 'tâm' to avoid collision with སེམས.
p0308 l.5, སྲང་མདའི་མཐོ་དམན — the beam of a balance, in the standard simile for the simultaneity of death and the intermediate state.

p0309–p0312. First member of the four-hữu set; identical in meaning to བར་དོ and rendered identically. Recorded separately so the Phase 5 sweep does not read the two Tibetan forms as one term nor as two different things.

p0309, in the Kośa verse and in Tsongkhapa's gloss. Third of the four hữu: from the second moment of birth up to before the last moment of dying. Rendered with the established Sino-Vietnamese 本有 rather than a literal 'hữu thuộc thời trước', because the passage turns on it being a technical set-member; the literal sense ('the one that is prior') is carried in the surrounding gloss, which the Tibetan itself spells out.
p0309. Fourth of the four hữu: the last moment of dying. 死有.
p0309. The set as a whole; built on the glossary's provisional སྲིད་པ = 'hữu'.

p0309, closing word of the Kośa verse, as a name for the antarābhava being. Established Vietnamese transliteration (健達縛), matching the Kośa's own usage. The literal Tibetan sense ('smell-eater') is not reproduced.
p0312, both the full and the bare form. Standard Vietnamese transliteration. The bare ཀུན་གཞི in ཀུན་གཞི་ཁས་མི་ལེན་པ་རྣམས is rendered bare 'a-lại-da'.

p0309 and p0310, twice, both times as Tsongkhapa's verdict on a groundless claim (སྒྲོ་བཏགས་ཁོ་ནའོ / སྒྲོ་བཏགས་སོ). Follows the glossary's སྒྲོ་འདོགས་པ = 'gán đặt' rather than the technical 'tăng ích'.

terms.vi: bản văn có nguồn gốc đáng tin cậy
terms.note: p0310, p0311, twice, in Tsongkhapa's two appeals to scriptural silence. Uses the phrase the glossary already fixes for ཁུངས་མ (རྒྱུད་སྡེ་ཁུངས་མ = 'bộ mật tục có nguồn gốc đáng tin cậy').

p0312, closing line. Contracted form of the glossary's མངལ་དུ་འཇུག་པ = *Kinh Nhập Thai*; rendered as the bare short title *Nhập Thai*, on the precedent of ལམ་སྒྲོན → *Đạo Đăng*. Recorded so the sweep does not read it as a second work.

terms.vi: tấm dạ đen / tấm dạ trắng
terms.note: p0310, the paired similes for the bardo of non-virtue and of virtue (AK III: kṛṣṇaśāṭaka / white wool). Both rendered as woollen cloth so the pair stays visibly parallel. See flag — ཕྱར་བ is not certainly 'woollen cloth'.
p0310, of the bardo of evil-doers: མིག་ཐུར་དུ་བྱས་ཏེ་སྤྱིའུ་ཚུགས་སུ་འགྲོ. Rendered descriptively (head-downward), no Sino-Vietnamese coinage.
p0311, ཕོ་མོའི་མཚན་མ་གཉིས་ཙམ. Rendered literally ('the two marks of male and female'); no euphemism supplied and none removed.

p0309, twice: prose `རྫུ་འཕྲུལ་དང་ལྡན་པ་བཞིན་དུ` and the Kośa verse `ལས་ཀྱི་རྫུ་འཕྲུལ་ཤུགས་དང་ལྡན`. No entry. Wording KEPT (no ruling to depart from), but it COLLIDES with the existing provisional `མངོན་པར་ཤེས་པ` (abhijñā) -> "thần thông": two distinct Tibetan terms on one Vietnamese word, the exact failure decisions.md §5 records for the reverence family. A ruling should split them, e.g. `རྫུ་འཕྲུལ` -> "thần biến" or "thần túc", reserving "thần thông" for `མངོན་པར་ཤེས་པ`. If the ruling lands elsewhere it must sweep both occurrences in c096 together.

The four-`སྲིད་པ` scheme this whole chunk turns on has no entries at all. `བར་དོ` and `བར་སྲིད` are used interchangeably by the source itself (p0309–p0311) and both render "trung hữu". Consistent with the recorded provisional `སྲིད་པ` -> "hữu". Section-headword level; should be fixed before later chunks.

p0309, the section headword `སྔོན་དུས་ཀྱི་སྲིད་པ་ནི` and inside the Kośa verse (`སྔོན་དུས་སྲིད་འབྱུང་ཤ་ཚུགས་ཅན`). "bản hữu" is the established Sino-Vietnamese for pūrvakālabhava; note it does NOT translate `སྔོན་དུས` literally, and the chunk's own following sentence turns on that literal sense ("cái ở trước, xét trong tương quan với tử hữu"), so the entry should record both the fixed compound and the fact that the bare `སྔོན་རོལ` / `སྔོན་དུས` is rendered literally where the text argues about it.
p0309, twice (`མིག་ནི་ལྷའི་མིག་ལྟར་ཐོགས་པ་མེད`; verse `རིས་མཐུན་ལྷ་མིག་དག་པས་མཐོང`, contracted `ལྷ་མིག`). No entry. First use.

p0310, `མི་དགེ་བ་བྱེད་པའི་བར་སྲིད་ནི་ཕྱར་བ་ནག་པོའམ`. No entry. COLLISION: `སྣམ་བུ་དཀར་པོ` in the very next sentence also renders "tấm dạ trắng", so two different Tibetan cloth-words land on one Vietnamese word inside a deliberate black/white pair. Wording kept (no ruling to depart from), but the pair should be split, e.g. `ཕྱར་བ` -> "tấm bạt"/"tấm choàng" vs `སྣམ་བུ` -> "tấm dạ" (སྣམ་བུ is specifically woollen serge). Both occurrences must be swept together if the ruling changes either.
p0310, `དགེ་བ་བྱེད་པའི་བར་སྲིད་ནི་སྣམ་བུ་དཀར་པོའམ`. See the `ཕྱར་བ་ནག་པོ` entry — same collision, rule the two together.

p0312, `ཁང་བཟང་དང་གཞལ་མེད་ཁང་ལ་སོགས་པའི་གནས`. No entry for the bare word; cf. the recorded compound `རྣམ་པར་རྒྱལ་བའི་ཁང་བཟང` -> "tòa lầu Tối Thắng", which uses "tòa lầu". A ruling should align them, and should be taken together with `གཞལ་མེད་ཁང` -> "vô lượng cung" in the same phrase, which is also unrecorded.

terms.vi: Quán xét qua cửa mười hai duyên khởi
terms.note: Section s112, path 6.2.3.1.4.2.2. Wording taken verbatim from c082, which announces this sa-bcad ('quán xét qua cửa khổ và tập; và quán xét qua cửa mười hai duyên khởi'). Uses the glossary's རྟེན་ཅིང་འབྲེལ་པར་འབྱུང་བ = duyên khởi.
Section s113, path 6.2.3.1.4.2.2.1. ཡན་ལག = chi (glossary, provisional), kept bare so the twelve stay countable, as the glossary note for ཡན་ལག requires.
p0313, 2×. Built on the glossary's སྡོམ་པ = luật nghi; the negated form names the butchers/sellers class.

p0313, p0316. The Tibetan literally reads 'born from warmth and moisture'; rendered with the established compact Sino-Vietnamese term so the four yoni stay parallel with the glossary's བརྫུས་ཏེ་སྐྱེ་བ = hóa sinh and c082's མངལ་སྐྱེས = thai sinh.
p0313, p0316. Fourth member of the yoni set; parallel to hóa sinh / thai sinh / thấp sinh.
p0313, p0316. Not previously registered although c082 already uses 'thai sinh'.

p0315, p0316 (3×). The earliest prenatal stage — 'the mer mer po of semen and blood into which consciousness first entered'. Rendered descriptively as 'phôi' rather than with a Sanskrit stage-name: Tibetan sources order མེར་མེར་པོ and ནུར་ནུར་པོ inconsistently, so identifying it with kalala (yết-lạt-lam) rather than arbuda would be a guess. See flags.

p0314, in Dharmakīrti's position. The glossary's གང་ཟག = 'hạng người' is explicitly restricted by its own note to enumerative, non-technical use; this passage is technical, and pairs with the glossary's ཆོས་བདག་མེད་པ = pháp vô ngã. Transliteration used rather than 'nhân vô ngã' so that གང་ཟག་ཏུ་འཛིན་པ two clauses later can use the same word. A ruling is needed. See flags.
p0314. Established Vietnamese name (法稱). Uses the glossary's སློབ་དཔོན་ཆེན་པོ = đại A-xà-lê. His *Pramāṇavārttika* is already in the corpus as *Thích Lượng Luận*.

terms.vi: hai anh em A-xà-lê Vô Trước
terms.note: p0314. ཐོགས་མེད = Vô Trước (fixed); སྐུ་མཆེད = brothers, i.e. Asaṅga with Vasubandhu. The Tibetan does not name the second brother, so the Vietnamese does not either.

p0314, 2×, the pivot of the vô minh definition. Kept distinct from འགལ་ཟླ = 'cái đối nghịch' (same sentences) and from ལྡོག་ཕྱོགས = 'phía nghịch lại'; all three occur within a few lines and must stay separable.
p0314, 3×. See the མི་མཐུན་ཕྱོགས note — three near-synonyms in one paragraph, deliberately given three Vietnamese words.
p0314. Third member of the same trio.
p0314, the opposite of མ་རིག་པ = vô minh, so it must be the same root word in Vietnamese. Kept apart from the glossary's རིག་པའི་གནས་ལྔ = năm minh xứ, which is a different sense.
p0315, in 'ཀུན་གཞི་ཁས་ལེན་པ་རྣམས' — those who do and do not assert it. Standard Vietnamese transcription; 'tàng thức' avoided because the Tibetan says only ཀུན་གཞི, not ཀུན་གཞི་རྣམ་ཤེས.
p0315. རྣམ་པར་ཤེས་པ = thức per the glossary's ཡིད་ཤེས note; ཚོགས = nhóm.

terms.vi: thức thuộc thời nhân / thức thuộc thời quả
terms.note: p0315, 4×, the causal-time and result-time consciousness of the third link. འབྲས་བུ = quả (fixed).
p0315, the definition of མིང in the danh-sắc link.
p0313, in འདོད་པ་ན་སྤྱོད་པ་དང་གཟུགས་ན་སྤྱོད་པའི་ལྷའི་རིས = 'các hàng chư thiên hành nơi cõi Dục và hành nơi cõi Sắc'. ན་སྤྱོད་པ kept literal ('hành nơi') rather than flattened to 'thuộc'.
p0314 l.1 (VN l.52). The term `བརྫུན` is set against in the Kośa analogy; needs registering alongside the noun sense of `བརྫུན` so the pair stays visibly a pair.
p0314 l.1 (VN l.57). No entry under either spelling. Already used identically in c091/c093/c098/c103, so registration is the only action needed.
p0314 l.1 (VN l.58), as `སློབ་དཔོན་ཆེན་པོ་ཆོས་ཀྱི་གྲགས་པ`. `སློབ་དཔོན་ཆེན་པོ` = "đại A-xà-lê" and `ཐོགས་མེད` = "Vô Trước" do match the glossary; only the name itself is unregistered.
Fourth limb; p0315 l.3 - p0316 l.3 (VN ll.86, 95). Unregistered.
p0315 l.3, p0316 l.3 (VN ll.36, 79, 83, 92). Unregistered.
p0313 (VN ll.14, 25-26), in the list of asaṃvara trades beside `ལུག་གསོད་པ` and `ཕག་ཚོང་མཁན`. Bracketed supply because the bare Tibetan is just 'fowl-person'. Unregistered.
p0313, p0316 l.3 (VN ll.32, 93). Unregistered.

p0314 l.1 (VN l.62), repaired this pass. Needs a ruling because it must stay distinct from `ཕྱིན་ཅི་ལོག་ཏུ་འཛིན་པ` = "chấp điên đảo" three lines earlier — the argument of the passage IS the distinction between mis-conceiving and merely-not-realizing, and against `མ་རྟོགས་པའི་བློ` = "cái trí không chứng ngộ". "phân biệt" follows the existing provisional `རྟོག་པ` = "phân biệt"; "tà phân biệt" was rejected as unidiomatic and "điên đảo" is taken.

terms.vi: Thí Dụ về Bảy Đồng Nữ
terms.note: p0334, cited twice in this section (also at p0333 in c102 — the two must match). Built like the glossary's དགེ་འདུན་སྲུངས་ཀྱི་རྟོགས་པ་བརྗོད་པ = 'Thí Dụ về Saṅgharakṣita': རྟོགས་བརྗོད = avadāna = 'thí dụ' (cf. རྟོགས་བརྗོད་བརྒྱ་པ = Bách Thí Dụ), གཞོན་ནུ་མ = đồng nữ (glossary uses གཞོན་ནུ = đồng tử), བདུན = bảy. Not verified against an existing Vietnamese edition.
p0335 verse. NOT new wording — translation/c091.md uses 'hoại tụ kiến' seven times for the same Tibetan — but glossary.json has no entry at all. Registration gap.

terms.vi: khí thế gian cùng tình thế gian
terms.note: p0334. Extends the glossary's སྣོད་ཀྱི་འཇིག་རྟེན = 'khí thế gian' (器世間) with the established counterpart 情世間 for བཅུད.
p0335, fifth member of the five-simile list. Established Sino-Vietnamese (乾闥婆城). No entry for bare དྲི་ཟ either.
p0334 prose (སྒྱུ་མ་སོགས་དང་འདྲ་བར) and p0335 verse. No glossary entry.
p0335 verse, first of the five similes. No glossary entry. Pairs with the existing སྨིག་རྒྱུ = 'quáng nắng'.
p0335, the point the Ugra citation is said to be chiefly about. No glossary entry; kept distinct from རབ་ཏུ་བྱུང་བ = 'xuất gia'.

p0335, inside the Ugra quotation. ལས = karman rendered by the established 'yết-ma' (羯磨), not by the glossary's ལས = 'nghiệp', because the list is of monastic acts. དགེ་འདུན = Tăng-già per the glossary.
p0335, second member of the same list. Established Vietnamese 'bố-tát' (布薩).
p0335, third member of the same list. Established Vietnamese 'tự tứ' (自恣).

p0335, fourth member of the same list, rendered literally from འདུད་པ = 'cúi lạy' as printed. See flag: this may be a source error for འདུན་པའི་ལས (chanda, the consent sent by an absent monk), which is the member usually listed beside saṃghakarman / poṣadha / pravāraṇā. NOT normalised.
p0334 (ཆོག་ཤེས་པ), also at p0333. Plain Vietnamese rather than Sino-Vietnamese 'tri túc', which would sit oddly beside the concrete list of robes and food.
p0335, དཀའ་ཐུབ་ཀྱི་རི་སུལ in Chekawa's saying. No glossary entry.
p0334 verse. Sanskrit name kept in transcription; no established Vietnamese name found.
p0334, བ་མོས་ལྕི་བའི་གོས = robes heavy with frost, in both the prose and the verse.
p0334 verse, in the simile ནེ་ཙོ་ལྟར་ལང་བ. See flag on ལང་བ.
p0334, prose and verse (ཆུ་ངོགས་སྨན་ལོངས). Read as the herb-meadow beside a river. See flag: the printed ལོངས is probably ལྗོངས.
p0334. No glossary entry for this compound; the several existing འཛིན་པ entries are all other compounds.
p0334, སྲིད་པའི་རྩ་བ་ལྟ་ངན་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་སྐྱེད་བྱེད. Built on the glossary's ལྟ་བ = 'kiến'.

terms.vi: các thế gian động và bất động
terms.note: p0335 verse. Rendered literally (moving / not-moving); the verse does not gloss them as sentient/insentient, so no such gloss was supplied. འཇིག་རྟེན = thế gian per the fixed entry.
p0334 verse. མཐོང་ཆོས = 'hiện pháp' following the glossary's མཐོང་ཆོས་ལ་མྱོང་བ = 'thọ [quả] trong hiện pháp'.

p0334, closing line of the Seven Maidens verse. སྦྱིན་པ = bố thí (fixed). Kept apart from ཡོན་གནས, which occurs a few lines earlier on p0333 (c102) in the same passage — the two should be ruled together.
p0335, in Chekawa's saying (ད་གཟོད་ཕས་བུ་གསོས་བྱ་བ་ཡིན). Rendered as the literal image; no explanation supplied in the text. See flag.

Cited at p0333 (and again at p0330/p0334, i.e. in c101 and c103 — this title should be fixed before those are done). Rendered literally from the Tibetan components, following the glossary precedent རྟོགས་བརྗོད་བརྒྱ་པ = 'Bách Thí Dụ' (རྟོགས་བརྗོད = avadāna = 譬喻 'thí dụ'). Both the long form (p0330) and the contracted form (p0333) name the same work.
p0333, Saptakumārikāvadāna verse. Established Sino-Vietnamese (糞掃衣); the Tibetan is itself descriptive ('robe of the rubbish heap'). Kept compatible with the registered ཆོས་གོས = 'pháp y'.

terms.vi: Ngăn dứt luân hồi bằng thân y như thế nào
