terms.note: Outline s120, path 6.2.3.1.7.1, level 5 → '#'. རྟེན = 'thân y' per the glossary (the physical basis for practice — and it is exactly that sense here: the section argues householder vs. ordained status). བཟློག་པ = 'ngăn dứt', following c035 line 46, which renders སྐྱེ་བ་བཟློག་པ in the same Suhṛllekha verse as 'ngăn dứt sự sinh'. The sibling heading ལམ་ཇི་ལྟ་བུ་ཞིག་བསྒོམས་པས་འཁོར་བ་བཟློག་པ (s121, in a later chunk) is previewed in the two-fold division as 'ngăn dứt bằng việc tu tập đạo như thế nào'.

p0333, གཞན་གྱི་ཡོན་གནས་བྱེད་པ. No entry. Rendered literally rather than with the Sino-Vietnamese 'phúc điền' (福田), which translates ཚོགས་ཞིང/བསོད་ནམས་ཞིང, a different Tibetan word the book uses elsewhere; keeping them apart matters.

p0332, Naljorpa Chenpo's saying ཕྱུགས་ལས་བྱེ་བྲག་འབྱེད་པའི་དུས. Deliberately NOT 'bàng sinh', which is the registered rendering of དུད་འགྲོ and occurs three lines earlier in the Suhṛllekha verse — ཕྱུགས is domestic livestock, not the realm-name.

p0332, prose ར�མོངས་ནས་བདེ་བར་འཛིན་པ and Jātakamālā verse དེ་ལ་དགའ་བ་རྨོངས་པ་ནི. Kept distinct from the registered གཏི་མུག = 'si mê', which appears in the second Jātakamālā verse on p0333 (དྲེགས་དང་ང་རྒྱལ་གཏི་མུག) — the two words stand ten lines apart and must stay separable.
p0333, ཁྱིམ་གྱི་སོ་ནམ ×2 in the Jātakamālā verse. Agriculture/husbandry as the emblematic householder occupation.
p0333, ཕ་རོལ་ཉེས་པ་བྱེད་པ་ལ་ནན་ཏུར་མི་བྱར་མི་རུང་ངོ — the coercion/punishment a householder cannot avoid inflicting.
p0333, ཁུང་དང་འདྲ་བ, the simile closing the snake-nest verse; a pit or hole, paired with སྦྲུལ་གྱི་ཚང ('tổ rắn') two lines above.
p0333. The monastic discipline of looking only a yoke's length ahead while walking. Rendered by the literal image; no established Vietnamese phrase was found.

p0333, དཔྱས་མེད་ཁྱིམ་ནས་ཁྱིམ་དུ་ནི. Taken from the lexical sense of དཔྱས་པ = to deride/censure. NOT confident — see flag; the alternative reading is 'without discriminating [between houses]', which fits the alms-round context equally well and would give a different Vietnamese.

p0333 (printed སློངས་མོ for སློང་མོ). Collides with the registered བསོད་སྙོམས = 'khất thực', which is a different Tibetan word; here the verb phrase is the act of going on the round, so 'đi khất thực' was used. A ruling should decide whether the two must be kept visibly apart.

p0333, `རྙེད་དང་བཀུར་སྟི་ཆགས་མེད་ཅིང`, c102 line 129. TEXT KEPT — this is the ruling the checker asked for, not a translator error. The glossary.json `བཀུར་སྟི` entry already names the expanded form explicitly: 'Inside the fixed compound རྙེད་བཀུར / རྙེད་པ་དང་བཀུར་སྟི it stays lợi dưỡng và cung kính', so the existing wording is exactly what the recorded entry prescribes; standalone `བཀུར་སྟི` = tôn trọng is not triggered here because `རྙེད` is present. Two things to record: (a) `རྙེད་དང་བཀུར་སྟི` (with `དང`, without `པ`) counts as the compound alongside `རྙེད་བཀུར` and `རྙེད་པ་དང་བཀུར་སྟི`; (b) reconcile the spelling discrepancy — the `རྙེད་བཀུར` entry in glossary.json reads 'lợi dưỡng cung kính' while decisions.md §5 and the `བཀུར་སྟི` note both read 'lợi dưỡng và cung kính'. Recommend the `và` form for the written-out pair and the bare form for the tight compound `རྙེད་བཀུར`, or unify on one; either way both files must be made to say the same thing.

p0331–p0333, used throughout c102 and in the section heading `རྟེན་ཇི་ལྟ་བུས་འཁོར་བ་བཟློག་པ།`. No entry. Rendering kept and used consistently. HIGHEST PRIORITY of the minor gaps: this is the headword of the whole section and should be pinned BEFORE the parallel chunk c103 (`ལམ་ཇི་འདྲ་བ་ཞིག་བསྒོམས་པས་བཟློག་པ`) is translated, or the two halves of one division will diverge.
p0333, `བསོད་སྙོམས་ཀྱིས་ཆོག་ཤེས་ཤིང`, c102 line 117; the negated form `ཆོག་མི་ཤེས་པར་ཚོལ་བ` = 'tìm cầu không biết đủ' at line 88. No entry. Standard; rendering kept.

terms.vi: việc đồng áng của gia đình
terms.note: p0333, c102 lines 94 and 98 (both inside the same Jātaka verse). No entry. Rendering kept and used consistently within the quotation.
p0332, c102 line 75. No entry. Rendering kept.

terms.vi: Ngăn dứt luân hồi bằng việc tu tập con đường như thế nào
terms.note: Outline s121, path 6.2.3.1.7.2, level 5 → '#' as the chunk's own heading. Its sibling s120 (རྟེན་ཇི་ལྟ་བུས་འཁོར་བ་བཟློག་པ, chunks c102/c103, not yet translated) has the identical frame and MUST be rendered 'Ngăn dứt luân hồi bằng thân y như thế nào' or the pair will split.

Turning saṃsāra back / bringing it to a stop. 'ngăn dứt' chosen over 'đoạn dứt' (which belongs to སྤོང་བ / གཅོད་པ) and over the interpretive 'chấm dứt'. Note the same root inside the Suhṛllekha verse is the different compound ཕྱིར་བཟློག (of a fire), rendered 'đẩy lùi'; the split is deliberate.

Cited twice on p0337, once via སའི་དངོས་གཞིར་དྲངས་པ (as quoted in the Bổn Địa Phần). Built on the pattern already fixed for དཔུང་བཟང་གིས་ཞུས་པ = Kinh Diệu Tý Thỉnh Vấn, སེང་གེས་ཞུས་པ = Kinh Sư Tử Thỉnh Vấn: ཞུས་པ = thỉnh vấn; ཚངས་པ = Brahmā = Phạm Thiên (established Sino-Vietnamese, and the Tibetan itself translates the name). Not verified against an existing Vietnamese edition.

No entry and no corpus precedent. Occurs 4× in this chunk (p0336 l.7 twice, p0337 l.3 twice) and 22× more across source/clean, almost all in the śamatha division — so it needs a CENTRAL ruling, not a per-chunk one. 'an trú trong định' re-uses 'định' (the fixed ཏིང་ངེ་འཛིན), which is defensible here because the text itself equates the two in the same sentence, but the precise Sino-Vietnamese 'đẳng dẫn' (等引) would keep samāhita and samādhi visibly apart.
p0336 l.5, l.7, l.9. The structural term organising the whole section (three grounds for the number being exactly three). Rendered descriptively rather than with the compact 數決定.

terms.vi: sự xác định về thứ tự
terms.note: p0337 l.3. Deliberate parallel to གྲངས་ངེས་པ above; རིམ་པ = 'thứ tự' follows c040.

p0337, in the Brahmaparipṛcchā verse and in the prose gloss, opposed to འཕགས་པའི་ལྟ་བ = 'kiến của bậc thánh'. Deliberately NOT 'tà kiến', which renders ལོག་ལྟ. Uses the glossary's provisional ལྟ་བ = kiến and the unruled སྡིག་པ = tội ác.

terms.vi: phá trừ / trấn áp / đoạn trừ tận gốc
terms.note: p0337 l.1, the three-way split of what each training does to the afflictions. 'phá trừ' follows the glossary's རྣམ་པར་སུན་འབྱིན་པ = 'sự phá trừ hoàn toàn' (the bare form drops 'hoàn toàn'). The three must stay distinct from one another.

p0337 l.1, with the honorific verb བཞེད, so persons (earlier masters), not 'the above [points]'. Consistent with the glossary's བླ་མ་གོང་མ = 'chư thượng sư tiền bối', which registers གོང་མ as the 'predecessor' modifier.

p0337 l.1. Extends the glossary's ཁམས་གོང་མ་གཉིས = 'hai giới trên', which is explicitly kept literal because the Tibetan does not name Sắc giới / Vô sắc giới. Same restraint applied to འདོད་པའི་བདེ་འགྲོ་གཉིས = 'hai thiện thú thuộc [cõi] Dục' (p0336 l.9), where 'cõi' is bracketed because the Tibetan writes only འདོད་པའི.

terms.vi: hội đủ bốn chỗ an trú an lạc
terms.note: p0337 l.5, second line of the Brahmaparipṛcchā verse on the nature of the three trainings. Rendered literally; the referent is not named by the text — see flag.

terms.vi: nhất định dẫn xuất đến giải thoát
terms.note: p0337 l.5. Kept apart from the glossary's ངེས་འབྱུང = 'xuất ly', which is the aspiration, not this deliverance-property of pure ethics.

terms.vi: điều cần thành tựu / phương tiện thành tựu
terms.note: p0337 l.1, the pair that structures the result-based enumeration (two goals, three means). No entry for either.

p0337 l.5, the ācāra/gocara pair; rendered 'hội đủ nghi quỹ và hội đủ hành cảnh' (c104 l.72). Bare ཆོ་ག has no headword. The only registered ruling is སྨོན་པའི་ཆོ་ག -> 'nghi quỹ tâm nguyện' (ritual sense), but the glossary note on འཚོ་བ already records the same ācāra sense in the four-member set ཚུལ་ཁྲིམས/ཆོ་ག/འཚོ་བ/ལྟ་བ -> 'giới, nghi quỹ, sinh kế, kiến' (p0209-p0210, 'ཆོ་ག = nghi quỹ follows c007/c040'). Text KEPT: precedent is consistent and the paired སྤྱོད་ཡུལ -> 'hành cảnh' is registered and correctly used. What is missing is the headword itself, with the ruling stating whether the ritual sense (軌則儀式) and the deportment sense (軌則/ācāra) share one Vietnamese word or split.

p0337 l.3, in the Brahmaparipṛcchā verse (འཕགས་པའི་ལྟ་དང་སྡིག་པའི་ལྟ) and in the prose gloss (སྡིག་པའི་ལྟ་བ་དང་བྲལ་བ); c104 l.55 and l.61. Text KEPT. This is the standing unruled split resurfacing, not drift introduced here: glossary.json holds two unreconciled provisionals for the bare term — `སྡིག་པ` -> 'tội lỗi' and `སྡིག་པ / སྡིག་པའི་ལས` -> 'tội ác / ác nghiệp / nghiệp tội ác', the latter explicitly marked 'Unruled ... one ruling needed, ideally a fixed-set'. 'tội ác' falls inside the second entry's list. Note for the ruling: here the term modifies ལྟ་བ (a wrong view), not an act, so a fixed-set would need a member usable attributively.

RAISED BY THIS REPAIR. p0337 l.1. Bare སུན་འབྱིན་པ has no headword; the only registered forms are རྣམ་པར་སུན་འབྱིན་པ -> 'sự phá trừ hoàn toàn' and རྣམ་པར་སུན་འབྱིན་པ་ཀུན་ཏུ་སྤྱོད་པ -> 'hành trì sự phá trừ hoàn toàn' (p0251, first of the four powers), both provisional and both noted 'No entry. Wording kept.' The fidelity check ruled 'phá trừ' a strength overstatement here, because this occurrence is the weakest member of a graded triad against སྤོང་བ ('đoạn trừ') in the same sentence; changed to 'bài xích'. That leaves the two renderings divergent by design, so a ruling is needed: either the four-powers sense (repudiating accumulated sin) and the graded-triad sense (undermining affliction) split by sense, or one word covers both and p0251 moves too.

RAISED BY THIS REPAIR. p0337 l.5. The past བསྡམས་པ governed by an instrumental སྡོམ་པས has no headword. Rendered 'được phòng hộ bằng luật nghi biệt giải thoát', following the registered བཤགས་བསྡམ -> 'sám hối và phòng hộ', whose note already establishes that བསྡམ from སྡོམ་པ is restraint/guarding rather than the noun 'luật nghi'. Registering it so the three senses of the སྡོམ་པ family stay separable in the Phase 5 sweep: the vow noun (སྡོམ་པ -> luật nghi), sense-restraint (དབང་པོའི་སྒོ་སྡོམ་པ -> thu thúc căn môn), and being bound/guarded by a vow (this entry).

Nāgārjuna. Cited at p0325 only through its commentary. Established Sino-Vietnamese title (六十正理論); རིགས་པ = chánh lý follows the glossary's གཏན་ཚིགས = chánh lý register. Not verified against an existing Vietnamese edition.

terms.vi: Chú Giải Lục Thập Chánh Lý Luận
terms.note: p0325, source of the 'three worlds ablaze with the fire of impermanence' passage. Built on the pattern already fixed for བཞི་བརྒྱ་པའི་འགྲེལ་པ → 'Chú Giải Tứ Bách Luận'.

terms.vi: Kinh Bí Mật Bất Tư Nghì
terms.note: p0326, three quotations. glossary.json already has the bare form གསང་བ་བསམ་གྱིས་མི་ཁྱབ་པ → 'Bí Mật Bất Tư Nghì' with the note that p0079 writes it without མདོ; here the source DOES write མདོ, so the 'Kinh' prefix is added. Same work, longer Tibetan form.

terms.vi: Bồ-tát Du-già Hành Tứ Bách Luận
terms.note: p0328. The full Tibetan title of Āryadeva's Catuḥśataka, which glossary.json already fixes in its short form བཞི་བརྒྱ་པ → 'Tứ Bách Luận'. Rendered component by component: བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའ = bồ-tát, རྣལ་འབྱོར་སྤྱོད་པ = du-già hành (cf. the glossary's རྣལ་འབྱོར་སྤྱོད་པའི་ས = Du-già Sư Địa), བཞི་བརྒྱ་པ = Tứ Bách Luận.
p0326, inside the Kinh Bí Mật Bất Tư Nghì quotation. NOTE: the Tibetan writes ཡོངས་སུ་འདས་པ་ཆེན་པོ with no མྱ་ངན, so 'bát-niết-bàn' supplies a component the Tibetan does not spell out. See flag.
p0325, inside the Yuktiṣaṣṭikāvṛtti quotation (ས་གསུམ་མི་རྟག་པ་ཉིད་ཀྱི་མེ). Rendered literally from ས་ = cõi/địa, གསུམ = ba; 'tam giới' deliberately not used, since the Tibetan writes ས་ not ཁམས་.
p0326, ཞི་བའི་མཐར་ལྟུང་བ = 'rơi vào biên tế tịch tĩnh'. Built on the glossary's ཞི་བ = tịch tĩnh; མཐའ = biên tế. No prior corpus precedent for མཐའ in this sense.
p0326, of the bodhisattva's resolve to train until saṃsāra's end. Rendered literally.

terms.vi: tội ác tác có nhiễm ô
terms.note: p0327, from the Bồ-tát Địa. Built on the glossary's ཉེས་བྱས = 'tội ác tác' plus ཉོན་མོངས་ཅན; kept distinct from bare ཉོན་མོངས = phiền não.
p0325. མཐིལ = the very bottom/core; follows the glossary's གདམས་ངག = giáo huấn.

p0325, in Sharawa's simile (སིང་སྐྱུར་ལ་བཏབ་པའི་ཕྱེ). Hapax in the whole corpus. Only སྐྱུར = 'chua' is secure; སིང་ is not identified, so the word is left in transliteration with a bracketed gloss rather than guessed. See flag.

terms.vi: Nguyệt Xứng · A-xà-lê Nguyệt Xứng · đại A-xà-lê Nguyệt Xứng
terms.note: GAP — no entry for ཟླ་བ་གྲགས་པ in either the bo or vi fields. p0327 l.1 (སློབ་དཔོན་ཟླ་བ་གྲགས་པས) and p0328 (སློབ་དཔོན་ཆེན་པོ་ཟླ་བ་གྲགས་པས). The prefixes follow the registered སློབ་དཔོན = 'A-xà-lê' and སློབ་དཔོན་ཆེན་པོ = 'đại A-xà-lê'; only the name itself needs a ruling. 'Nguyệt Xứng' (月稱) is the established Sino-Vietnamese form, not verified against an existing Vietnamese edition.

GAP — no entry for either form. p0326 l.3 (སློབ་པར་གོ་ཆ་བགོས་པ་ན). Note for the ruling: the bracketed gloss '[nguyện]' was REMOVED from this chunk as a fabrication, so the entry should state plainly that གོ་ཆ is rendered without importing the doctrinal 'armour of aspiration' reading unless སྨོན་ལམ is actually in the Tibetan.

terms.vi: [không dịch — nghi là lỗi bản gốc]
terms.note: Not a glossary term but needs recording alongside them: p0328, inside the Catuḥśataka-ṭīkā quotation, the print reads གང་ལ་ཕའམ་མའམ་བུའམ་བུ་མོའམ་ཉེ་དུའམ་སྣག་གི་གཉེན་མཚམས་གང་ཡང་རུང་བའི་གནས་དང་འདྲ་བར་མི་སྨྲ་བ. སྣག yields no sense in the list of kinship terms and looks like a defect of this edition (cf. FINDINGS §8.6). Left unemended and untranslated, with an inline note. Suggested chunk flag: 'unsure: སྣག་གི་གཉེན་མཚམས (p0328) — âm tiết སྣག nghi lỗi bản gốc'.

Not a glossary term but recorded here for the same reason: p0326 l.1 reads བྱང་ཆུབ་དཔའ་ལ་ནི་དེ་བསྒོམ་པ་མི་རིགས་ཏེ, missing སེམས་. Translated as plain 'bồ-tát' with an inline note; the print is not emended. Suggested chunk flag: 'unsure: བྱང་ཆུབ་དཔའ (p0326) — thiếu སེམས་, lỗi chính tả bản gốc'.

terms.vi: chi năng dẫn / chi sở dẫn
terms.note: p0321. The four-fold division of the twelve links. Built on the glossary's འཕེན་བྱེད = 'dẫn nghiệp' (引業, c073/c074) — here the word qualifies ཡན་ལག, not ལས, so 能引支/所引支 = 'chi năng dẫn'/'chi sở dẫn', keeping ཡན་ལག = chi per the glossary so the 2½ + 4½ + 3 + 2 count stays legible. c094 already uses 'tập đế năng dẫn' for འཕེན་བྱེད་ཀྱི་ཀུན་འབྱུང, so 'năng dẫn' is already in the corpus.

terms.vi: chi năng thành / chi sở thành
terms.note: p0321. The other half of the same four-fold division (能成支/所成支). Fixed together with འཕེན་བྱེད/འཕངས་པ above so the four stay morphologically parallel.

p0322 (Nāgārjuna verse and prose), p0324 (the painted wheel). Transparent compound, following the glossary's ཆོས་ཀྱི་འཁོར་ལོ = 'bánh xe Pháp' and སྲིད་པ = 'hữu' (which the སྲིད་པ entry insists must stay apart from འཁོར་བ = luân hồi). NOT 'bánh xe luân hồi', which is reserved here for འཁོར་བའི་འཁོར་ལོ at p0324 — the two Tibetan phrases occur two lines apart.

terms.vi: bánh xe luân hồi có năm phần
terms.note: p0324, the five-sectioned wheel the Buddha orders painted in the gatehouse. Rendered literally; kept distinct from སྲིད་པའི་འཁོར་ལོ = 'bánh xe hữu' in the next clause.

terms.vi: chiều thuận và chiều nghịch / chiều nghịch chiều thuận
terms.note: p0322-p0324. Rendered literally rather than with the Sino-Vietnamese 'lưu chuyển / hoàn diệt' (流轉/還滅), which would import the doctrinal gloss of cessation that the Tibetan does not write. Word order follows the Tibetan in each case (ལྡོག་འཇུག = nghịch then thuận).
p0324, inside the Vinaya citation. The Tibetan does not name Śāriputra and Maudgalyāyana, so neither does the translation. མཆོག = tối thắng per the corpus.

terms.vi: kẻ cộng trú / kẻ cận trú
terms.note: p0324, Vinaya citation. Standard Vinaya pair (共住/近住). 'kẻ' supplied only as a nominaliser; 'đệ tử' was deliberately not added inside the quotation.

p0323. Established Sino-Vietnamese 稻稈經. Cited here without མདོ (p0320, in c098, has the full སཱ་ལུ་ལང་པའི་མདོ), so 'Kinh' is bracketed as supplied. Not verified against an existing Vietnamese edition — see flag.

p0323. glossary.json already has དཔུང་བཟང་གིས་ཞུས་པ = 'Kinh Diệu Tý Thỉnh Vấn' (p0064). Here the Tibetan writes རྒྱུད, not མདོ, so the genre word is rendered 'Tục' rather than 'Kinh'. The two should be cross-linked as one work cited under two genre labels.

p0324, Vinaya citation. Transcribed from the Tibetan spelling as printed (ཨུ་ཏྲ་ཡ་ན), following the project practice of leaving Sanskrit names in transcription. Almost certainly Udrāyaṇa/Rudrāyaṇa of Roruka — deliberately NOT normalised. See flag.

p0321-p0322. glossary.json rules གང་ཟག = 'hạng người' (provisional), which does not work inside the pudgala-nairātmya idiom. 'bổ-đặc-già-la' is already in the corpus at c039. Needs a scoped ruling — see flag.

terms.vi: Hoàn tất trong bao nhiêu đời
terms.note: Outline s115, path 6.2.3.1.4.2.2.3, level 7 → '##' (rendered one level below the chunk's own s117). See flag: the printed heading spells རོགས་པ, the body རྫོགས་པ.

terms.vi: Tóm lược ý nghĩa của các điều ấy
Mức độ phát sinh ý lạc ấy
terms.note: Outline s117, path 6.2.3.1.5, level 4 → '#'. Built to mirror the glossary's སྐྱེས་བུ་ཆུང་ངུའི་བསམ་པ་སྐྱེས་པའི་ཚད = 'Mức độ phát sinh ý lạc của bậc hạ' (s088), its structural twin: བསམ་པ = ý lạc, ཚད = mức độ.

CONFLICT, not a translator error. Two competing provisional entries exist: སྲེད་པ = 'khát ái' (from a p0182 verse, chosen to keep it apart from འདོད་ཆགས = 'tham ái') and སྲེད = 'ái' (from a p0166 verse). c099 uses 'ái' throughout — སྲེད་པའི་ཆུས -> 'nước ái' (p0321), སྲེད་ལེན་སྲིད་པ་གསུམ -> 'ái, thủ, hữu' (p0321), ད་ལྟའི་སྲེད་ལེན་གྱིས -> 'ái và thủ' (p0322). In the twelve-links context the eighth limb is idiomatically 'ái' and it must pair with 'thủ' and 'hữu', so 'khát ái' would break the standard enumeration. Needs a ruling now, before it spreads across the remaining twelve-links chapters; recommend 'ái' as the twelve-links limb, with 'khát ái' retained only where it must be held apart from འདོད་ཆགས in the same sentence.
p0322, བློ་སྦྱོང་མཛད་ཅིང. Rendered descriptively rather than as the loan 'lojong'. A ruling matters because this is also the name of a genre the book refers to elsewhere.

p0324, རྒྱལ་པོ་ཨུ་ཏྲ་ཡ་ན. Transliterated as the Tibetan spells it; no established Sino-Vietnamese form was assumed. A ruling should decide transliteration vs. a Sino-Vietnamese rendering, and whether to hyphenate (U-tra-ya-na) in line with 'bổ-đặc-già-la' / 'Diêm-phù-đề' elsewhere in this chunk.

terms.vi: Kinh Điều Rất Đáng Quý Trọng Đối Với Tỳ-kheo
terms.note: p0339. Rendered literally from the Tibetan components (དགེ་སློང = tỳ-kheo per glossary; རབ་ཏུ་གཅེས་པ = rất đáng quý trọng). Not verified against any existing Vietnamese or Sanskrit title — see flags.

p0341. Rendered on the precedent of the glossary's ཡང་དག་པར་ལྡན་པའི་ལུང = 'Tương Ưng A-hàm' (ཡང་དག་པར་ལྡན་པ = samyukta = tương ưng). The literal alternative reading is 'đầy đủ giới chân chánh' (śīla-sampanna); that entry is itself marked unverified — see flags.

p0340, closing line of the Vinayavibhaṅga verse. ཀླུ = loài rồng per the glossary; the name is kept in Sanskrit transcription rather than translated ('rồng lá ela'), as with other Indic proper names in the corpus.
p0339, verse, opposed to ཚུལ་ཁྲིམས་ལྡན་པ = 'người có giới' in the same quatrain.
p0338, third aspect of the truth of cessation, in the list of the sixteen aspects.

p0338, fourth aspect of the truth of the path. Deliberately marked with 'năng' to keep it apart from ངེས་འབྱུང = 'xuất ly' (glossary), which is the fourth aspect of the truth of cessation in the SAME sentence — the two Tibetan words would otherwise collapse.
p0338, third aspect of the truth of origin, beside ཀུན་འབྱུང = 'tập khởi' in the same list.

terms.vi: bốn chỗ an trú của tâm
terms.note: p0338, glossed by the text itself as the four བསམ་གཏན (tĩnh lự) and identified with the training in mind.
p0341, inside the sūtra quotation. Not the registered ལྟུང་བ = 'đọa tội' (āpatti, a monastic offence) but the fall/ruin sense, matching the corpus's separate 'đọa lạc' entry for non-āpatti ལྟུང་བ.
p0339, Subāhuparipṛcchā verse, ཆོས་དཀར་མཆོག. Same Vietnamese as the registered དཀར་ཆོས / དཀར་པོའི་ཆོས = bạch pháp.
p0338, Mahāparinirvāṇa quotation, first of the ten similes for morality.
p0339, same quotation. Expanded to two Vietnamese nouns because the Tibetan compound joins གོ་ (armour) and མཚོན་ (weapon).
p0339, same quotation: provisions for the perilous road of existence. ཚོགས here is the 'store/collection' sense, not the registered ཚོགས = tư lương.
p0339, same quotation, contrasted with ཚོང་པ = 'thương nhân'.
p0341, གོས་ངུར་སྨྲིག་བགོས་པ. Rendered by the colour, as the Tibetan writes it, rather than by the established 'y ca-sa', which would import a Sanskrit term the line does not have.
p0341. འཁོར་བ = luân hồi (fixed); འདུས་བྱས = hữu vi, already the corpus rendering.
p0341, the image governing the closing simile that runs on into the next chunk.
p0339, Nāgārjuna verse, ཡོན་ཏན་ཀུན་གྱི་གཞི་རྟེན. Kept distinct from the provisional རྟེན = 'thân y' (the bodily basis), a different sense.
p0340, Vinayavibhaṅga verse, སྨིག་ཚལ་བྲེགས་པས་ཨ་མྲའི་ཚལ་ཉམས. Read as a thicket of reed/bamboo (cf. སྨྱིག་མ). Uncertain — see flags. ཨ་མྲ = xoài (āmra).
p0347. Kadampa master quoted with ཞལ་ནས. Tibetan name left in transcription, following the glossary's ཕུ་ཆུང་བ = Puchungwa, སྣེའུ་ཟུར་པ = Neusurpa, དགོན་པ་བ = Gönpawa.
p0346. Kadampa master quoted with ཞལ་ནས. Transcription, same pattern as the other Kadam names.
p0346. glossary.json has bare ཕུ་ཆུང་བ = Puchungwa; the དགེ་བཤེས-prefixed form follows དགེ་བཤེས་སྟོན་པ = 'ngài Geshé Tönpa'.

terms.vi: Kinh Khuyến Phát Thắng Ý Lạc
terms.note: p0349. Full spelling of the glossary's ལྷག་བསམ་བསྐུལ་བ; same Vietnamese title reused, recorded only so the variant spelling resolves.
p0348, ཐེ་ཚོམ་གྱི་ཕྲ་རྒྱས. No glossary entry; standard Sino-Vietnamese 隨眠.

terms.vi: sự lưu chuyển và hoàn diệt của luân hồi
terms.note: p0347, as the object of skill produced by meditating on རྟེན་འབྲེལ. Rendered with the established Sino-Vietnamese pair for the forward/reverse order; no entry existed.
p0347, ལྟ་བ་ལྔ་ལ་སོགས་པའི་ལྟ་ངན. The Tibetan does not enumerate them, so the rendering was kept generic rather than naming the five.
p0348, ཕྱི་དང་ནང་གི་མི་སྡུག་པ — the antidote object for འདོད་ཆགས. No entry.
p0348, in the list of ཉེ་བའི་ཉོན་མོངས. Negatives of the glossary's ངོ་ཚ་ཤེས་པ / ཁྲེལ་ཡོད་པ = tàm / quý.
p0348. Rendered as the negation of the glossary's ཤེས་བཞིན = tỉnh giác rather than as Sino-Vietnamese 'bất chánh tri', so the pair stays visibly linked.
p0349, the three humours in the Adhyāśayasaṃcodana verse on sleep. No Vietnamese convention exists; rendered literally.
p0349, first line of the Jātakamālā verse that runs into c108. Rendered by sense ('lord of gods') rather than as 'Đế Thích', since the Tibetan uses the descriptive form.
p0347, in Nyugrumpa's instruction. ཁྲོ་བོ has no entry; 'minh chú' is bracketed because the Tibetan says only 'wrathful recitation'.
p0349, Suhṛllekha verse on the five hindrances.
p0349, third of the five སྒྲིབ་པ in the Suhṛllekha verse. Kept distinct from འདོད་ཆགས = tham ái and སྲེད་པ = khát ái, which both occur in this same chunk.
p0348. Almost certainly the four noble truths, but the Tibetan does not say 'four', so the rendering was left unspecified rather than resolved to 'Tứ Đế'.

NO entry. In `སྐྱེ་བོ་བྱིས་པ` (p0349, Udānavarga) it was rendered "phàm phu", which asserts an ordinary-being sense the bare word does not carry and collides head-on with the registered `སོ་སོའི་སྐྱེ་བོ` = "phàm phu" (provisional). Changed to "hạng người". Needs a ruling that keeps `སྐྱེ་བོ` and `སོ་སོའི་སྐྱེ་བོ` separable.

NO entry. c107 p0347 `ཁྲོ་བོའི་བཟླས་པ` -> "trì tụng [minh chú] phẫn nộ" — wording KEPT, no ruling exists. Collision: "phẫn nộ" is already the registered rendering of `ཁོང་ཁྲོ` (krodha-as-affliction, provisional), so a wrathful deity class and an affliction currently share one Vietnamese word. Ruling should probably give the deity sense a distinguishing head, e.g. "bổn tôn phẫn nộ" / "phẫn nộ tôn", and leave bare "phẫn nộ" to `ཁོང་ཁྲོ`.

NO entry. c107 p0347 `གང་ཞིག་བསྒྲིམས་ཏེ་ཁྲོ་འཇོམས་པ` (Bodhicaryāvatāra) -> "Người nào cố gắng diệt trừ sân giận" — wording KEPT, no ruling. But `ཞེ་སྡང` = "sân hận" (registered, provisional) appears ten lines earlier in the same passage, and "sân giận" / "sân hận" are near-indistinguishable in Vietnamese. Needs a ruling covering `ཞེ་སྡང` / `ཁྲོ་བ` / `ཁོང་ཁྲོ` together.

The registered person entries are mutually inconsistent on the honorific: `པོ་ཏོ་བ` = "ngài Potowa" (carries "ngài") but `ཕུ་ཆུང་བ` = "Puchungwa" and `དགོན་པ་བ` = "Gönpawa" (bare). c107 has four masters quoted with `ཞལ་ནས` in fifteen lines; following the entries as recorded now produces "Geshé Puchungwa" and "Gönpawa" bare beside "ngài Potowa", "Ngài Nyugrumpa", "Ngài Langri Thangpa". One policy is needed: either "ngài" on every master's name, or on none, with the honorific carried by the speech verb ("dạy") alone. I followed the recorded entries rather than the chunk's internal consistency; a single ruling should settle it and trigger a corpus sweep.

p0348 l.1, `འདོད་ཆགས་སྲེད་པ་ཡིན་ལ` — an unmarked juxtaposition with no `དང`. I removed the draft's inserted "và" rather than decide whether this is one compound or two coordinated terms; the Tibetan does not say. The `འདོད་ཆགས` entry's own note already flags the tham ái / khát ái collision as unruled. A ruling on the pair should also say how the bare juxtaposition is to be rendered.

NO entry. p0349 `དཀར་པོ་ཉམས་ཤིང་མུན་པར་འགྲོ་བར་འགྱུར` — bare `དཀར་པོ` ("the white") opposed to `མུན་པ` ("darkness"). Currently "bạch [phần]" with the supplied noun bracketed. A ruling would let it be unbracketed; note that "pháp bạch" must not be used, as `ཆོས` is absent and "pháp" is reserved for `ཆོས`.
p0342, Samādhirāja verse (འདུས་བྱས་དག་ལས་འབྲོས་པར་འདོད) and p0341 prose (འདུས་བྱས་འཁོར་བ). Not registered. Rendered with the established Sino-Vietnamese 有為.
p0342, metrical form of བདེ་གཤེགས, which glossary.json already registers as 'đấng Thiện Thệ' (provisional). Registered only so the sweep does not read the ར form as a separate term.

p0342-p0343, two quotations. Built from the glossary's བྱམས་པ = Di-lặc (person sense) and the pattern of སེང་གེས་ཞུས་པ = 'Kinh Sư Tử Thỉnh Vấn'; སེང་གེ་སྒྲ rendered with the established 師子吼 = Sư Tử Hống. Not verified against an existing edition.
p0344. Built from the glossary's འཇམ་དཔལ = Văn-thù plus རྩ་རྒྱུད = căn bản mật tục (རྒྱུད = mật tục per རྒྱུད་སྡེ = 'bộ mật tục'). Not verified against an existing edition.

p0343, paired with རབ་བྱུང་གི་རྟགས as the two things a lay mantrin is exempt from. ཆོ་ག = nghi quỹ per c007/c040; ལས rendered with the established Sino-Vietnamese 羯磨 = yết-ma rather than literally 'nghiệp'. Not verified against an existing edition — see flags.

p0343. Built from the glossary's རབ་ཏུ་བྱུང་བ = xuất gia and the rendering of རྟགས as 'hình tướng' already fixed in དགེ་སྦྱོང་གི་རྟགས = 'hình tướng sa-môn'. The same word stands bare in the verse just above ('bỏ hình tướng và nghi quỹ').

terms.vi: hành giả mật chú là cư sĩ / hành giả mật chú đã xuất gia
terms.note: p0343, the contrasted pair. སྔགས་པ = hành giả mật chú (glossary); ཁྱིམ་པ kept as 'cư sĩ' to honour the glossary's ཁྱིམ་པ = 'hàng cư sĩ' rather than switching to 'tại gia' — see flags.
p0344, first line of the Mañjuśrīmūlatantra verse (ཟློས་པ་འདི་ལ་ཚུལ་ཁྲིམས་ཉམས). The mantra-reciter. Not registered.

terms.vi: tất-địa (tối thượng / bậc trung / bậc hạ)
terms.note: p0344. glossary.json registers only དངོས་གྲུབ = 'tất-địa'; here the bare གྲུབ་པ carries the same sense in a three-level list, so the same word is used. Kept distinct from the verbal འགྲུབ་པ ('thành tựu') in the same verse.
p0344. Built on the glossary's མྱ་ངན་ལས་འདས་པ = niết-bàn; གྲོང = thành. Parallel to ཐར་པའི་གྲོང་ཁྱེར on p0341 ('thành giải thoát').
p0344, in ངའི་བླ་མའི་བཀའ་བརྒྱུད (Geshé Tönpa on his guru's transmission). Not the school name; rendered as the ordinary word for an oral transmission lineage.
p0345, འདུན་མའི་ཞབས in Atiśa's account of how decisions were settled at Vikramaśīla. Not registered; rendered as the deliberative assembly. See flags for ཞབས.

terms.vi: cố ý tạo tác điều đáng phải tạo tác
terms.note: p0342-p0343, inside the Maitreyasiṃhanāda quotation. Rendered descriptively; the doubling of the Tibetan is kept rather than collapsed.
p0344, one of the five qualities in Sharawa's saying. ཞེ = the inward mind, གཙང་བ = clean.

p0345, དྲན་པ་དང་ཤེས་བཞིན་གྱི་སོ་བཙུགས — posting mindfulness and introspection as a sentry. སོ = spy/sentinel; rendered literally so the military image of the whole passage (kẻ thù, ngọn giáo, chiến đấu) is kept.

Casing ruling needed for BARE `སྔགས` as against `གསང་སྔགས` (registered = 'Mật chú', capitalised). c106 currently writes lowercase 'mật chú' for bare `སྔགས` at L67, 70, 72, 75, 77, 83, 93, 97, 102, 117, 118 and capitalised 'Mật chú' only at L63 and L80, which are exactly the two places the Tibetan reads `གསང་སྔགས` — so the chunk is internally principled but resolves the open question the opposite way from c008, c009, c039, c041, c042, c101, c109, which all capitalise. Left unchanged pending the central ruling the `གསང་སྔགས` note already asks for. `སྔགས་པ` = 'hành giả mật chú' is registered and unaffected.

Bare `གྲུབ་པ` in the siddhi sense, as in the Mañjuśrīmūlatantra verse p0344 `གྲུབ་པ་མཆོག` / `གྲུབ་པ་འབྲིང` / `གྲུབ་པ་ཐ་མ` (c106 L89-91: tất-địa tối thượng / bậc trung / bậc hạ). glossary.json registers only `དངོས་གྲུབ` = 'tất-địa'. Rendering kept: consistent with c005, c008, c020, c023, c024. Note `གྲུབ་པ` also occurs in this chunk as plain 'thành tựu' (`སྔགས་འགྲུབ་པ`), so the entry should be scoped to the siddhi sense.

p0343 `དེ་ལྟ་བུའི་ཚུལ་གྱིས་བསྲུང་བ` -> c106 L62 'Việc phòng hộ theo cách như thế'; also p0342 `ཡོངས་སུ་རྫོགས་པར་བསྲུང་བ` -> L27 'gìn giữ trọn vẹn viên mãn'. No entry exists, so the verb floats between 'phòng hộ' and 'gìn giữ' within one chunk. A ruling is worth having in this section because the vow vocabulary is dense: `སྡོམ་པ` = luật nghi and `སྡོམ་སེམས` = tâm ngăn giữ are already registered, and `བསྲུང་བ` is the only one of the three unruled.

p0358, of Prajñāpāramitā: ཤེར་ཕྱིན་ལ་ཡུམ་ཞེས་ཀྱང་གསུངས་པས ... སྲས་ཀྱི་ཡུམ. glossary.json has only the compound རྒྱལ་བའི་ཡུམ → 'Phật mẫu của chư Đấng Chiến Thắng'. 'Phật mẫu' was deliberately NOT used for the bare word here because the sentence turns on the literal mother/sons figure (སྲས་ཀྱི་ཡུམ), which 'Phật mẫu' would flatten.
p0359, རྒྱལ་བའི་དགོངས་པ་འགྲེལ་བ་ལ་ཚད་མར་གྱུར་པའི་རྒྱལ་སྲས་རྣམས. ཚད་མ = lượng (pramāṇa) kept visible rather than paraphrased as 'chuẩn mực', so the epistemological term is not lost.
p0360, in the list of practices that do not count as bodhisattva conduct without bodhicitta. Standard Sino-Vietnamese triad.
p0360, inside the Bodhicaryāvatāra quotation. Rendered from the Tibetan components (དུས་མཐའ = cuối thời/tận kiếp, མེ = lửa) rather than with the bare Sino-Vietnamese 'kiếp hỏa'.
p0360, last words of the chunk, inside the Bodhicaryāvatāra simile (the tree that dies after fruiting). The verse's བཞིན་དུ ('like') falls on p0361, so 'như' is supplied in brackets.
p0360, in the worldly simile རྩྭ་རྔ་བ་དང་ཟོར་བ་བརྡར་བ = 'cắt cỏ và mài liềm'. བརྡར་བ = mài; རྔ་བ / བརྔས་པ = cắt (cỏ).
p0360, བྱ་རོག་ལ་ཟན་ཉུང་ཟད་ཅིག་བྱིན་པ. ཟན rendered 'thức ăn', consistent with the glossary's ཟན་ཆངས་གཅིག = 'một vắt thức ăn'.
p0359, twice: prose རྨད་དུ་བྱུང་བའི་ལམ and the Bodhicaryāvatāra verse སྔ་ན་མེད་པའི་རྨད་ཅིག. Paired in the same sentence with ཡ་མཚན་པར་འཛིན = 'xem là điều kỳ diệu'; the two are kept apart.
p0359. Kept distinct from རྨད་དུ་བྱུང་བ = hy hữu, which occurs in the same sentence.

p0359, བྱང་སེམས་ཀྱི་ལམ་གྱི་དགག་བྱའི་གཙོ་བོ. Rendered descriptively; the Sino-Vietnamese 'sở phá' would be the technical alternative and should be settled centrally, since དགག་བྱ recurs heavily in the ལྷག་མཐོང section.

p0358, ཤེས་པས་སྲིད་ལ་མི་གནས་ཤིང, quoted from རྗེ་བཙུན་བྱམས་པ. Rendered 'trí' to keep it apart from ཤེས་རབ = trí tuệ, which Tsongkhapa's own prose gloss immediately after substitutes for it — the gloss was deliberately NOT absorbed into the quotation.
p0358, ཆོས་རྒྱུས་ཤིན་ཏུ་ཆུང་བར་གསལ་ལོ. རྒྱུས = acquaintance/familiarity. See flag — the reading is probable but not certain.

terms.vi: đi đúng vào chỗ trọng yếu
terms.note: p0360. Rendered identically to the glossary's གནད་དུ་སོང་བ = 'đi đúng vào chỗ trọng yếu' (p0057). Note the intrusive ཞིག in this occurrence — see flag.

p0359, སེམས་ཀྱི་དམ་པ་རིན་ཆེན (L68, Bodhicaryāvatāra citation). No bare adjectival ruling exists, so the text was KEPT per the repair rule — but flagged as genuinely contestable: every registered དམ་པ renders it in the 'chân chính / chân nhân / Chánh / Diệu' family (སྐྱེས་བུ་དམ་པ, བཤེས་གཉེན་དམ་པ, དམ་པའི་ཆོས, དམ་པ་སངས་རྒྱས), and 'tối thắng' collides with the mchog/uttama family (note L76 already uses 'tối thượng' for གདམས་པའི་མཆོག twelve lines away). A ruling for adjectival དམ་པ should settle this together with the open དམ་པ་སངས་རྒྱས flag.

p0360 (L88), in the list ཚུལ་ཁྲིམས་ནས་ཤེས་རབ་ཀྱི་བར་དང་ལྷ་བསྒོམ་པ་དང་རྩ་རླུང་ཐིག་ལེ་སོགས. No entry for ལྷ in the deity sense. 'bổn tôn' is the established Vietnamese for ཡི་དམ (iṣṭadevatā), which is narrower than what the source writes (ལྷ alone). Text kept; 'tu quán bổn tôn' vs 'tu bổn tôn' vs a literal 'tu thiên' should be settled before the tantra sections.

p0359 (L49), རྒྱལ་བའི་དགོངས་པ་འགྲེལ་བ་ལ་ཚད་མར་གྱུར་པའི་རྒྱལ་སྲས་རྣམས. glossary.json has only ཚད་མེད་བཞི; no entry for ཚད་མ. 'lượng' is the bare Sino-Vietnamese calque and reads opaquely in this non-epistemological use (here: authoritative / a valid source). Text kept; candidates 'bậc lượng / đáng tin cậy / chính lượng' need one ruling, since ཚད་མ recurs in the vipaśyanā sections.

p0360 (L95), སྐད་ཅིག་རེ་རེ་ལ་སྒྲིབ་པ་སྦྱོང་བ་དང་ཚོགས་སྡུད་པ — the obscuration/accumulation pair, so āvaraṇa, not nīvaraṇa. The only bare entry is སྒྲིབ་པ -> 'triền cái' (the five hindrances), whose own note already concedes the obscuration sense is used elsewhere without a ruling (see also the ཟས་སྐོམ་ལ་སྒྲིབ་པ flag). Text kept; the glossary needs the second, scoped entry so a Phase 5 consistency sweep does not read this as drift.

terms.vi: hành xả / thọ xả / xả vô lượng
terms.note: p0373, the three kinds of བཏང་སྙོམས listed together; the text says 'here it is the last'. 'xả vô lượng' matches the glossary's ཚད་མེད་བཞི = 'bốn vô lượng'. The three must be fixed as a set.

terms.vi: tâm bình đẳng / tâm không bình đẳng
terms.note: p0373-p0374, ~10× — the headword of section 6.2.3.1.9.2.1.2.1.1.1. Rendered 'bình đẳng' rather than 'xả' precisely so it stays separable from བཏང་སྙོམས. Note translation/c023.md l.95 already uses 'tánh bình đẳng' for a different Tibetan (ཆོས་མཉམ་པ་ཉིད); the collision is mild but should be checked.

terms.vi: Tu tập cái trí mong cầu lợi ích cho kẻ khác
terms.note: Outline 6.2.3.1.9.2.1.2.1, level 8. Follows translation/c082.md, which renders the exactly parallel ཐར་པ་དོན་གཉེར་གྱི་བློ as 'cái trí mong cầu giải thoát'. NOTE the tension with the glossary's བློ་སྦྱང་བ = 'tu tâm': here བློ carries a qualifier so the compound is split, and 'tu tâm' cannot absorb it. Its sibling heading བྱང་ཆུབ་དོན་དུ་གཉེར་བའི་བློ་སྦྱང་བ (p0387, chunk c119) must take the same shape.

terms.vi: Thành tựu nền tảng để cái trí ấy sinh khởi
terms.note: Outline 6.2.3.1.9.2.1.2.1.1, level 9. གཞི rendered 'nền tảng' (non-technical sense) per the glossary note that reserves 'cơ sở' for the four-fold karmapatha frame.

terms.vi: Thành tựu tâm bình đẳng đối với chúng sinh
thành tựu việc hết thảy [chúng sinh] mang hành tướng khả ái
terms.note: Named in the enumeration on p0373; it is the section heading of chunk c115 (outline 6.2.3.1.9.2.1.2.1.1.2), so c115 must match. ཡིད་འོང = 'khả ái' per c024/c029/c067; རྣམ་པ = 'hành tướng' per c028/c029.

terms.vi: Kinh Nguyệt Thượng Đồng Nữ Thỉnh Vấn
terms.note: p0374. Built on the pattern already fixed for དཔུང་བཟང་གིས་ཞུས་པ / བློ་གྲོས་རྒྱ་མཚོས་ཞུས་པ (ཞུས་པ = thỉnh vấn). ཟླ་བ་མཆོག = Candrottarā = 月上 Nguyệt Thượng (established Sino-Vietnamese); བུ་མོ = đồng nữ. Not verified against an existing Vietnamese edition.

p0374. Short form of the glossary's བསྒོམ་པའི་རིམ་པ = Tu Tập Thứ Đệ; བར་པ = 'quyển giữa', on the pattern of translation/c011.md l.28 which renders ཐ་མ as 'quyển cuối'. Registering only fixes that the abbreviated སྒོམ་རིམ takes the same Vietnamese title as the full form.

terms.vi: thiên vị / phân chia thiên vị / có thiên vị / không thiên vị
terms.note: p0373, 3× in one sentence. The related bare རིས་སུ་གཅོད་པ at p0374 rendered 'phân chia phe phái'.
p0373, the neutral third party in the equanimity sequence friend / neutral / enemy: ཕན་ཡང་མ་བཏགས་གནོད་པའང་མ་བྱས་པའི་བར་མ. Recurs throughout the བདག་གཞན་བརྗེ་བ chapters.

p0374 line 1, དམིགས་རྟེན་བྱས་ནས. Built on the glossary's དམིགས་པ = 'sở duyên'; རྟེན adds the sense of the support one bases the meditation on, rendered 'đối tượng'. Cross-check with the existing དམིགས་རྣམ = 'sở duyên và hành tướng' entry.
p0374, 3×, contrasted with དགྲ = kẻ thù. Must NOT collide with the glossary's གཉེན་པོ = 'đối trị' or དཔུང་གཉེན = 'người thân trợ giúp'.
p0374, closing sentence. Contraction of ཁོང་ཁྲོ + ཆགས་པ, both of which appear in full earlier in the same section; rendered with the same two words so the back-reference stays visible.

p0373, in the section heading. translation/c100.md uses both 'lợi ích chúng sinh' and the compact 'lợi tha' for this notion; a single ruling is owed, since གཞན་དོན names one of the two halves of this whole chapter (paired with བྱང་ཆུབ་དོན་དུ་གཉེར་བ).
p0373, first of the three-fold division of བཏང་སྙོམས. No entry. Sino-Vietnamese 行捨, standard for this Abhidharma item; formed on the same pattern as the other two members of the triad.
p0373, third of the three-fold division and the sense operative in this whole section (འདིར་ནི་ཐ་མ་ཡིན). No entry. Aligns with ཚད་མེད་བཞི = 'bốn vô lượng' already in the glossary.

p0373–p0374, ~10 occurrences; the sa-bcad headword སེམས་ཅན་ལ་སེམས་སྙོམས་པ་བསྒྲུབ་པ and its negative སེམས་མ་སྙོམས་པ = 'tâm không bình đẳng'. No entry. No competing rendering exists in translation/ ('bình đẳng' elsewhere occurs only in c023, unrelated sense). Needed fixed before the following chunks, which continue this section.

The bare verbal noun, used ~20× in this chunk as the topic of the section (སེམས་དེ་ཇི་ལྟར་བསྐྱེད་པའི་ཚུལ). Glossary has བྱང་ཆུབ་ཀྱི་སེམས = bồ-đề tâm but no ruling for the act. Kept as 'phát tâm', matching the scattered prior uses in c009/c028/c039/c040/c081.

terms.vi: lòng mong cầu chứng đắc Phật quả / việc chứng đắc Phật quả
terms.note: The Tibetan has only སངས་རྒྱས ('a buddha'); Vietnamese needs 'quả' to parse. Supplied unbracketed as established idiom — a ruling should confirm or require brackets.
p0363, twice, once paired with གཟུགས་ཀྱི་སྐུ which the glossary already fixes as 'Sắc thân'. The pair should be registered together.
p0362–p0363, ×3. ཞི་བ follows the glossary ('tịch tĩnh'), though that entry was set for the samādhi sense; here ཞི་བ is the hīnayāna peace, contrasted with སྲིད་པ (hữu). རྐྱང་པ = 'chỉ riêng'.

terms.vi: tự lực / tha lực / nhân lực / gia hành lực
terms.note: p0364, the སྟོབས་བཞི of bodhicitta generation (Bodhisattvabhūmi). NOT the glossary's སྟོབས་བཞི = 'bốn lực' (the four opponent powers of purification, 6.2.3.1.1.2.2.4) — two different fours; the entry needs disambiguating. སྦྱོར་བ = gia hành follows the glossary.

terms.vi: bốn nhân / bốn duyên / tám nhân duyên
terms.note: p0361–p0364. The chunk's three-part structure: four conditions, four causes, four powers; the closing Bodhisattvabhūmi citation counts causes+conditions as 'tám nhân duyên'.
p0363. Must NOT take the glossary's ཡི་དམ = 'bổn tôn' (the yidam deity) — here ཡི་དམ is a pledge/vow. Same syllables, unrelated sense; the existing entry needs a scope note.
p0362, ཆོ་འཕྲུལ་ངོ་མཚར་བ་རྣམས = 'các thần biến kỳ diệu'.

p0361, in the list of degenerate-age faults. Built as the negatives of the glossary's ངོ་ཚ་ཤེས་པ / ཁྲེལ་ཡོད་པ = tàm / quý. Note the glossary's existing preference for the descriptive 'không biết hổ thẹn' at p0224–p0225; the Sino-Vietnamese pair was used here because both members occur together and must stay distinct.
p0364, སྙིགས་མ་ལས་ཀྱང་ཆེས་སྙིགས་མར་གྱུར་པའི་དུས = 'thời đã trở nên trược hơn cả trược'. Glossary has only the compound སྙིགས་མ་ལྔ = ngũ trược; the bare word had no ruling.
p0364, འཁོར་བའི་དཀའ་སྤྱད་ལ་མི་སྐྱོ་བ, third of the four causes. 'khổ hạnh' was rejected as importing asceticism the Tibetan does not specify.

terms.vi: tiêu chuẩn của [tâm] đã phát khởi
terms.note: p0361, third member of the section's fourfold outline — i.e. the measure by which one knows bodhicitta has arisen. Will recur as a section headword.

terms.vi: sự đoạn trừ và sự chứng ngộ
terms.note: p0363. Rendered literally rather than as the Sino-Vietnamese 'đoạn đức / chứng đức', which would add 'đức' the Tibetan lacks.

terms.vi: phát tâm viên mãn trọn vẹn các tướng
terms.note: p0363, the chunk's key distinction against 'སེམས་བསྐྱེད་པ་ཙམ' (chỉ đơn thuần là phát tâm). མཚན་ཉིད read as 'characteristic' → the glossary's 'tướng' — see flags.

p0360–p0361, the Bodhicaryāvatāra simile completed at the head of this chunk (ཆུ་ཤིང = plantain, exhausted after fruiting; ལོན་ཤིང = the bodhicitta tree). The first line of the verse falls in c110, so the two chunks must agree on 'cây chuối'.

terms.vi: chứng đắc Phật quả / an lập vào Phật quả
terms.note: 10 occurrences in this chunk (p0362-p0364). `སངས་རྒྱས` alone is FIXED = 'Phật'; here the Tibetan has no `འབྲས་བུ` / `གོ་འཕང` / `ས`, so 'quả' is supplied. It is supplied because Vietnamese cannot say 'mong cầu chứng đắc Phật' — with an attainment verb the object must be the state, not the person, and 'Phật quả' is the established Vietnamese for that state. Requested ruling: register `སངས་རྒྱས་ཐོབ་པ` (and its variants with `ཐོབ་འདོད` / `འགོད་པ`) as a licensed compound = 'chứng đắc Phật quả' / 'an lập vào Phật quả', recorded as an exception to the fixed `སངས་རྒྱས` = 'Phật' so the sweep does not read 10 hits as drift. Text unchanged.

No entry at all. This chunk has both: p0361 `མཐུ་བསམ་གྱིས་མི་ཁྱབ་པ`, `མཐུ་ཆེའོ` (now 'năng lực', corrected away from 'thần lực' — `མཐུ` is plain power, with no divine/supernatural component) and p0364 `རང་གི་མཐུས` / `གཞན་གྱི་མཐུས` -> 'sức của chính mình' / 'sức của kẻ khác' (untouched; that passage passed). The word must be pinned AGAINST `སྟོབས`, which this same chunk renders 'lực' (`སྟོབས་བཞི` -> 'bốn lực', per the registered `སྟོབས` = lực) — so 'sức', 'năng lực' and 'lực' are now all in play within four pages. Suggested ruling: `མཐུ` = 'năng lực' as a noun, 'sức' in the instrumental `མཐུས` where 'năng lực' is unwieldy, and `སྟོབས` keeps 'lực' exclusively; or collapse `མཐུ` onto one form. Not decided here.

Twice at p0363 (`སངས་རྒྱས་ཀྱི་ཆོས་ཀྱི་སྐུ`, and paired with `གཟུགས་ཀྱི་སྐུ`). No entry exists for either the full or the contracted form; only its pair `གཟུགས་ཀྱི་སྐུ` = 'Sắc thân' is registered (provisional, p0260), whose own note asks for a ruling collapsing full and contracted forms. The rendering is the established Sino-Vietnamese and matches its registered pair; it just needs registering, ideally in the same ruling as `གཟུགས་ཀྱི་སྐུ`. Text unchanged.

The NEGATED pair inside a kleśa enumeration has no ruling. The positive pair `ངོ་ཚ་ཤེས་པ` / `ཁྲེལ་ཡོད་པ` = 'tàm / quý' is registered (provisional, p0226), and its note records that `ངོ་ཚ་མེད་པ` in the five-mind lists (p0224, p0225) was deliberately rendered descriptively, 'không biết hổ thẹn'. The corpus therefore now carries two treatments of the negated form and needs one. Two things to settle together: (a) descriptive vs. the Sino-Vietnamese 'vô tàm / vô quý' in kleśa lists; (b) the orthography of the source here — as printed, only `ཁྲེལ` carries `མེད` (`གཏི་མུག་དང་ངོ་ཚ་དང་ཁྲེལ་མེད་དང་...`), so 'vô tàm' depends on `མེད` distributing leftward across `དང་`. Wording kept and the reading now carries an inline note; the ruling is owed.

ALIAS, not an error. Only the full form `མངོན་པར་རྟོགས་པའི་རྒྱན` is registered (provisional, same Vietnamese). p0364 cites the contracted form. Register the contraction as an alias of the same entry so the two do not read as unregistered drift. Text unchanged.

p0364 l.3, `འདིར་དམ་པ་བསྟེན་ཅིང` in the fourth of the four powers. Only `སྐྱེས་བུ་དམ་པ` = 'bậc chân nhân' is registered; the separate `བཤེས་གཉེན་དམ་པ / དམ་པའི་བཤེས` entry renders attributive `དམ་པ` as 'chân chính'. Bare `དམ་པ` standing alone for holy persons is unruled — and the glossary already carries an identical open question from p0189 (`དམ་པ་སངས་རྒྱས`), so one ruling should cover both. Note that this chunk's `དམ་པའི་བཤེས` -> 'bậc thiện tri thức chân chính' matches its registered entry exactly. Text unchanged.

terms.vi: Trình bày rằng cửa ngõ để thể nhập Đại thừa chỉ là sự phát tâm
terms.note: Outline s123, path 6.2.3.1.8, rendered as '#'. འཇུག་སྒོ built from སྒོ = 'cửa ngõ' (corpus-wide) plus c040's 'Cửa ngõ để thể nhập Đại thừa'; ཁོ་ན = 'chỉ ... mà thôi' compressed to 'chỉ là'.
p0355–p0356, ~7×: the person who is a Mahāyānist, as against ཐེག་པ་ཆེན་པོ = Đại thừa (the vehicle). ཐེག་ཆེན་པར་ཆུད་པ → 'nhập vào hàng người Đại thừa'.

terms.vi: tu tâm theo thứ đệ của đạo bậc thượng
terms.note: p0354, the three-fold division that introduces this section. Built from the fixed སྐྱེས་བུ་ཆེན་པོ = bậc thượng, the provisional བློ་སྦྱང་བ = tu tâm, and c039/c042's 'thứ đệ của đạo bậc thượng' for ལམ་གྱི་རིམ་པ.
p0354, inside the Ba-la-mật Tập verse. Built on the glossary's ཐུབ་པ = 'đấng Mâu-ni' and ཐུབ་དབང = 'đấng Mâu-ni Vương'.

p0355. འཕགས་པ = Thánh (glossary 'bậc thánh', shortened in a title as with འཕགས་པ་དཔའ་བོ = 'bậc Thánh Dũng'); བྱམས་པ = Di-lặc (person sense, fixed). རྣམ་པར་ཐར་པ here is vimokṣa in a text title, NOT the biographical 'hành trạng' sense the glossary records, and not ཐར་པ = giải thoát as a common noun. No 'Kinh' prefix: the source writes no མདོ.

p0356, twice, inside the Vajrapāṇi tantra (གཟུངས་སྔགས་ཆེན་པོའི་དཀྱིལ་འཁོར → 'mạn-đà-la đại đà-la-ni chú'). གཟུངས = đà-la-ni per the glossary's དཀོན་མཆོག་ཏ་ལ་ལའི་གཟུངས; kept distinct from bare གསང་སྔགས = Mật chú and from bare སྔགས = chú thuật.
p0356, paired with གསང་སྔགས in the tantra's closing prohibition. Established Sino-Vietnamese 手印.
p0356, opening the tantra quotation. A third form beside the glossary's བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའ་སེམས་དཔའ་ཆེན་པོ = 'bồ-tát ma-ha-tát' and སེམས་དཔའ་ཆེན་པོ = 'bậc đại sĩ'. See flag: read as vocative.

p0355, the simile in the Maitreya passage, 4×. Rendered from the components (རྡོ་རྗེ = kim cang, རིན་པོ་ཆེ = quý báu) rather than as 'bảo châu kim cang', so that 'cái tên kim cang quý báu' in the same sentence stays literal.
p0356, Nāgārjuna verse (རི་དབང་རྒྱལ་པོ་ལྟར་བརྟན). Rendered from the components; the referent (Meru) is not named by the Tibetan and is deliberately not supplied.

terms.vi: đi theo hay quay lui tùy thuận vào
terms.note: p0355, positive/negative concomitance with the presence of bodhicitta. Follows the glossary's འཇུག་དང་ལྡོག་པ = 'sự nhập vào và sự quay lui' in using ལྡོག = quay lui.

terms.vi: thành tựu một cách phụ đới
terms.note: p0354: one's own aim accomplished incidentally through working for others' aim.
p0354, འགྲོ་བ་ཀུན་གྱི་གསོས་སུ་འགྱུར་བ. Restorative/nourishment, standing beside སྨན = thuốc in the same list. See flag — the sense is not certain.
p0356, ཡེ་ཤེས་ཆེན་པོར་དབང་བསྐུར་བ = 'lễ quán đảnh vào đại trí'. Built on the glossary's ཡེ་ཤེས = trí (kept apart from ཤེས་རབ = trí tuệ, which occurs in this same chunk).

terms.vi: lúa mạch / lúa gạo / lúa mì / đậu
terms.note: p0357, the seed-and-sprout analogy for common vs. uncommon causes. Named separately so 'nhân bất cộng của mầm lúa mạch' stays distinguishable from 'mầm lúa gạo'.
p0357, in the བོད / རྒྱ / ཧོར triad. Left as the Tibetan ethnonym rather than resolved to 'Mông Cổ' or 'Hồi Hột', which the Tibetan does not specify.

NO entry exists. p0354 l.3 and l.5 — the headword of section 6.2.3.1.8 `ཐེག་ཆེན་གྱི་འཇུག་སྒོ་སེམས་བསྐྱེད་ཁོ་ནར་བསྟན་པ` and of the whole `སེམས་བསྐྱེད` division, plus `སེམས་བསྐྱེད་ནས་སྤྱོད་པ་ལ་སློབ་པའི་ཚུལ` and `སེམས་བསྐྱེད་མ་ཐག་ཏུ` (p0355 l.1). c109 uses 'sự phát tâm' in the heading (line 38) and 'phát khởi tâm' / 'phát tâm' in prose (lines 35, 52, 68); also `ཐམས་ཅད་མཁྱེན་པར་སེམས་བསྐྱེད་པ` → 'tâm phát khởi hướng đến Nhất Thiết Trí' (line 76). Wording KEPT. Needs one central ruling (headword form plus permitted prose variants) before more chunks fix it by habit; it will recur constantly. Note the interaction with the existing `ཐམས་ཅད་མཁྱེན་པའི་སེམས` entry.

NO entry exists; contracted form `ཐེག་མཆོག` occurs too. p0354 l.1 `ཐེག་པའི་མཆོག་འདིར་འཇུག་པར་བྱའོ` (line 22) and the Pāramitāsamāsa verse `ཤེས་རབ་རྣམ་དག་མངོན་སྒྲུབ་ཐེག་པའི་མཆོག` (line 26); p0357 l.1 Ratnagotravibhāga verse `ཐེག་མཆོག་ལ་མོས་ས་བོན` (line 130). Rendered 'thừa tối thượng' at all three; wording KEPT. Should be recorded and kept distinct from `ཐེག་པ་ཆེན་པོ` → 'Đại thừa', since both appear in this chunk; a ruling should cover the contraction `ཐེག་མཆོག` too.

NO entry exists; raised by this repair. p0357 l.1, Nāgārjuna verse `ཐར་པའི་ལམ་ནི་གཅིག་ཉིད་ཁྱོད` (c109 line 144). `ཁྱོད` is the plain, non-honorific second person (contrast `ཁྱེད`), and these four pages never name the addressee — in context it may be bodhicitta itself rather than a person. The honorific capitalised 'Ngài' was replaced with plain 'ngươi' so no honorific register and no identity is asserted, but Vietnamese has no register-neutral second person: 'ngươi' carries a superior-to-inferior colouring of its own. Note that the same chunk renders `ལག་ན་རྡོ་རྗེ་ཁྱོད་ཀྱིས` (p0356 l.1, line 94) as lowercase 'ngài' for a NAMED addressee. A project-wide ruling is needed on how `ཁྱོད` / `ཁྱེད` map onto Vietnamese pronouns, and on what to do when the addressee is unnamed. The next chunk continues this verse and must not inherit the choice unexamined.

terms.vi: Tu tâm nơi thứ đệ của đạo bậc thượng
terms.note: Printed heading at the top of p0352, on its own line — but it is NOT in source/outline.json (the outline nests everything from p135 to p968 under 6.2.3.1, so the three capacity-divisions never became outline entries). Wording taken verbatim from translation/c042.md, which renders the same phrase inside the p0135 enumeration as 'tu tâm nơi thứ đệ của đạo bậc thượng'. Set as '##' to parallel c042's '## Thứ đệ của đạo cộng thông với bậc hạ' (outline level 3). See flags — the level is inferred, not verified against the PDF.

p0352, Pāramitāsamāsa verse: ཐུབ་རྒྱལ་ཐེག་པ = 'thừa của đấng Mâu-ni Vương' (the Mahāyāna). Built on the glossary's ཐུབ་པ = 'đấng Mâu-ni'; རྒྱལ = vương (牟尼王). Deliberately NOT 'Đấng Chiến Thắng', which is fixed for རྒྱལ་བ.

p0350, the name by which Gönpawa addresses Neusurpa (vocative). Contracted personal name (ཡེ་ཤེས་འབར). Left in Tibetan transcription like the other Kadam names; the glossary already has སྣེའུ་ཟུར་པ = Neusurpa, and this is the same man under his given name.

p0351, twice: prose 'ཉོན་མོངས་པའི་དགྲ་ལ་འཐབས་ནས་རྒྱལ་བ་ལ་དཔའ་བོ་ཞེས་བྱ' and the Bodhicaryāvatāra verse 'དེ་དག་རྒྱལ་བྱེད་དཔའ་བོ་སྟེ'. SCOPE SPLIT REQUEST: glossary.json has bare དཔའ་བོ = 'đấng Dũng Mãnh', explicitly scoped to the vocative epithet of the Buddha at p0188, and འཕགས་པ་དཔའ་བོ = 'bậc Thánh Dũng' (Āryaśūra). Neither covers the ordinary noun 'a hero' used here of any practitioner. 'dũng sĩ' chosen to stay clear of both.
p0353, three occurrences: prose 'བདེ་བ་དང་བརྗིད་བག་དང་སྐྱེས་བུའི་རྩལ' and the Śiṣyalekha verse 'དེ་འདིའི་བརྗིད་བག་ཡིན་ཏེ'. One word used for both so the verse visibly answers the prose.

terms.vi: khí lực của bậc trượng phu
terms.note: p0353, prose and Śiṡyalekha verse (same pairing as བརྗིད་བག above). སྐྱེས་བུ = 'bậc trượng phu' per the glossary's provisional bare-སྐྱེས་བུ entry; རྩལ = 'khí lực'. Note the glossary's own flag that 'trượng phu' is contestable — if that is re-ruled, this moves with it.

terms.vi: chủng tánh của Đấng Chiến Thắng
terms.note: p0352-p0353. Uses the glossary's རིགས = 'chủng tánh' (gotra) rather than its རིགས་སྐྱེས་པའི་མི = 'dòng dõi' sense, because the sentence is about who is fit to take up others' welfare. Kept distinct from རྒྱལ་བའི་རྒྱལ་རིགས in the verse four lines later.

terms.vi: vương tộc của Đấng Chiến Thắng
terms.note: p0353, Pāramitāsamāsa verse. A different Tibetan word (རྒྱལ་རིགས, kṣatriya/royal caste) from the རིགས of the prose immediately before it, so it takes a different Vietnamese; རྒྱལ་བ = Đấng Chiến Thắng per the fixed entry.

p0350, Suhṛllekha verse. Rendered from the Tibetan components (ལུས་གཏོགས = thuộc về thân, དྲན་པ = niệm) rather than the Sino-Vietnamese 'thân niệm xứ', which would import the smṛtyupasthāna frame the verse does not write. དྲན་པ recurs bare in line 4 of the same verse as 'niệm'.

terms.vi: con đường độc nhất phải đi
terms.note: p0350, Suhṛllekha verse. Rendered descriptively; 'nhất thừa đạo' avoided because it would collide with ཐེག་པ (thừa), which is a live term two pages later.

p0350, opening word of the Suhṛllekha verse. Read as the vocative by which Nāgārjuna addresses the king throughout that letter (cf. the glossary's རིགས་པའི་བདག་ཉིད = 'đấng có bản tánh chánh lý', registered for exactly this position in another Suhṛllekha verse at p0098). NOT the deity Īśvara and not the glossary's འཇིག་རྟེན་དབང་ཕྱུག = Thế Tự Tại. See flags — the parse is not certain.
p0350, ཉོན་མོངས་སུན་འབྱིན་པ་ལ་འབད་ནས. The word's ordinary logical sense is 'to refute'; here it is applied to the afflictions, so 'đả phá' rather than 'bác bỏ'.
p0350. Paired in the same clause with ཕྱོགས་མི་འཛིན་པ = 'chẳng đứng về phía'; the two are near-synonyms in the source and are kept as two distinct Vietnamese phrases so the doubling survives.
p0352, the simile for སྲིད་པ (hữu). རླུབས = pit/hollow.
p0353, Śiṣyalekha verse; an epithet of the sun standing in apposition to ཉི་མ. Rendered literally rather than as a second word for 'mặt trời', so the apposition stays visible.
p0352, ཉམ་ང་བ་དང་བྲལ་བའི་ཕྱོགས = 'phía lìa khỏi hiểm nguy'. Kept distinct from འཇིགས་པ (sợ hãi).

Bare དྲན་པ at l.19 and l.22 (p0350, Suhṛllekha verse: ལུས་གཏོགས་དྲན་པ, དྲན་པ་ཉམས་པས). The glossary rules only the compound དྲན་པ་དང་ཤེས་བཞིན => 'chánh niệm và tỉnh giác'; there is no ruling for the bare term. Wording KEPT. A ruling is needed on whether bare དྲན་པ takes plain 'niệm' (as here, and as in the registered titles དྲན་པའི་ཚོམས = 'phẩm Niệm', དྲན་པ་ཉེ་བར་བཞག་པ = 'Niệm Xứ') or 'chánh niệm', which currently differs from it by one word.

l.76 ('Thứ đệ của đạo cộng thông với bậc trung') and the l.78 top-level heading སྐྱེས་བུ་ཆེན་པོའི་ལམ་གྱི་རིམ་པ་ལ་བློ་སྦྱང་བ. The existing རིམ་པ entry is provisional 'trình tự' and its note says the split ('thứ đệ' in fixed compounds/titles vs 'trình tự' for bare sa-bcad usage) is NOT yet ruled. Wording KEPT because it matches that proposed split, but this chunk carries a top-level division heading, so the ruling should be closed before the sweep.
p0350, l.41, inside Gönpawa's instruction to Neusurpa (ལས་རྒྱུ་འབྲས་ལ་ཇེ་ངེས་ཇེ་ངེས་སོང་ནས). No entry. Wording KEPT. Recurs constantly in the karma chapters, so it should be pinned once.

p0352, l.83 (སྲིད་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་མེ་འབར་བའི་རླུབས་ལྟར་མཐོང => 'thấy hết thảy hữu đều như hố lửa đang cháy rực'). No entry. Wording KEPT; 'hố lửa' renders རླུབས as pit/hollow with མེ་འབར་བ supplying the fire.

terms.vi: Trình tự tu tập bồ-đề tâm
terms.note: Outline s126, path 6.2.3.1.9.2, level 5 → '#'. སྦྱང་བ = 'tu tập' per the glossary's སྐྱབས་འགྲོ་སྦྱང་བ = 'tu tập quy y'; རིམ་པ = 'trình tự' per the recorded sa-bcad precedent (c004/c005/c018); བྱང་ཆུབ་ཀྱི་སེམས = bồ-đề tâm (fixed).

terms.vi: Tu tâm qua cửa bảy khẩu quyết nhân quả
terms.note: Outline s127, level 6 → '##'. བློ་སྦྱང་བ = 'tu tâm' (glossary); མན་ངག = 'khẩu quyết' (glossary); སྒོ་ནས = 'qua cửa' following c097 ('Quán xét qua cửa mười hai duyên khởi').

terms.vi: Phát sinh sự xác quyết về trình tự
terms.note: Outline s128, level 7 → '###'. ངེས་པ = 'sự xác quyết' (glossary, provisional).

terms.vi: Chỉ rõ cội gốc của đạo Đại thừa là lòng bi
terms.note: Outline s129, level 8 → '####'. སྙིང་རྗེ = 'lòng bi' (glossary fixed 'bi'; 'lòng bi' is the corpus's prose form, c014/c019/c049); རྩ་བ = 'cội gốc' per c040.

terms.vi: bảy khẩu quyết nhân quả / bảy nhân quả
terms.note: The name of the whole method taught in c112–c115. Built on the glossary's མན་ངག = khẩu quyết. Occurs both in the full form (heading) and contracted (རྒྱུ་འབྲས་བདུན = 'bảy nhân quả').
Fifth of the seven causes and effects (p0365). དྲིན rendered 'ân đức' per the glossary's བཀའ་དྲིན = ân đức, so that it stays visibly the same word as in དྲིན་དྲན་པ.
Sixth of the seven (p0365). Deliberately NOT 'tùy niệm ân đức', which the glossary reserves for བཀའ་དྲིན་རྗེས་སུ་དྲན་པ — the Tibetan here has plain དྲན་པ with no རྗེས་སུ.
Seventh of the seven (p0365), the root of the whole method. 'chúng sinh' is bracketed: the Tibetan says only 'seeing as mother' and names no object.

p0365, fourth of the seven. Follows the note already recorded under ལྷག་བསམ་བསྐུལ་བ = 'Kinh Khuyến Phát Thắng Ý Lạc' (ལྷག་བསམ = thắng ý lạc). The text then shortens it to བསམ་པ, rendered 'ý lạc ấy' so the back-reference stays visible.

terms.vi: Kinh Vô Tận Tuệ Sở Thuyết
terms.note: p0366. Built on the pattern of the glossary's བློ་གྲོས་རྒྱ་མཚོས་ཞུས་པ = 'Kinh Hải Tuệ Thỉnh Vấn': བློ་གྲོས་མི་ཟད་པ = Vô Tận Tuệ, བསྟན་པ = sở thuyết. 'Kinh' is supplied (the Tibetan has no མདོ), exactly as in that precedent. No existing Vietnamese edition checked.

p0366. Rendered as a bare transcription of the Tibetan spelling rather than identified, because the identification is editorial. Almost certainly the Gayāśīrṣa-sūtra (Già-da Sơn Đảnh): the dialogue quoted (a devaputra asks Mañjuśrī for the ārambha and the basis of bodhisattva conduct) is that sūtra's, and གཽ་རི most likely transcribes giri = 'mountain'. See flag — a ruling is owed before the title recurs.

p0367, cited inside the Bhāvanākrama quotation. འཕགས་པ = 'Thánh' as a title prefix, following c083's *Thánh Giải Thâm Mật* (no 'Kinh' added there, so none added here). དད་པ = lòng tin in prose (glossary), but the Sino-Vietnamese 'tín lực' is used inside the title, as the corpus does for cited titles.

p0366, vocative inside the Akṣayamatinirdeśa quotation. Left in transcription following c005's practice for Sanskrit names, rather than the established 'Xá-lợi-phất' / 'Xá-lợi Tử', because the Tibetan writes ཤཱ་ར་དྭ་ཏིའི་བུ (son of Śāradvatī), not ཤཱ་རིའི་བུ. See flag.
p0366, address to Śāradvatīputra. No entry; the only registered བཙུན་པ is inside ཚིག་བཙུན་པ = 'được tôn trọng', a different use.
p0367–p0368, Bhāvanākrama II quotation. Built on the glossary's མྱ་ངན་ལས་འདས་པ = niết-bàn; མི་གནས་པ = vô trụ, the established Sino-Vietnamese 無住涅槃.
p0368, Dharmasaṃgīti quotation. Note that དཔུང་གི་ཚོགས in the same sentence is 'binh chúng' — ཚོགས here is an assembly, NOT the glossary's ཚོགས = tư lương.

p0368, the pivot image of the Madhyamakāvatāra homage and of Tsongkhapa's gloss on it (ལོ་ཏོག 3×). Kept as one Vietnamese word in all three places, including སངས་རྒྱས་ཀྱི་ལོ་ཏོག = 'mùa màng của quả Phật'.

p0366–p0367. The uncontracted form of the already-registered ཐེག་དམན = Tiểu thừa; both spellings occur in this chunk (ཐེག་པ་དམན་པར་ལྟུང་བ, ཐེག་དམན་བཞིན) and are rendered identically so the sweep does not read them as two terms.
p0365, third item in the list of wrong motives for generating bodhicitta (beside 'being urged by others' and the obscure གཡམ་ལ་རྒྱུགས). Only occurrence in the corpus.

p0365. Follows c028's rendering of the only other occurrence (p0086, གཞན་གྱི་གཡམ་ལ་རྒྱུག), which translates གཡམ literally as 'bãi đá lở' and marks the idiom inline as unresolved. Same inline marker used here. See flag.
p0366, paired with རྩོམ་པ = 'sự khởi đầu'. 'nền tảng' follows the glossary's གནས་ལ་དད་པ note, which already renders གནས as 'nền tảng' rather than 'xứ' or 'trú xứ'.

terms.vi: Nguyệt Xứng / Đấng Cát Tường Nguyệt Xứng
terms.note: p0368, introducing the Madhyamakāvatāra homage verse. NO bo entry exists for the name anywhere in glossary.json, although 'Nguyệt Xứng' is already used in c042 ('đại A-xà-lê Nguyệt Xứng') and c100, and three existing notes name Candrakīrti in prose (the ཚིག་གསལ་བ, སྐྱབས་འགྲོ་བདུན་ཅུ་པ and དབུ་མ་ལ་འཇུག་པ entries). c112's 'Đấng Cát Tường Nguyệt Xứng' for the honorific form དཔལ་ལྡན་ + name is unobjectionable and was kept. Register both the bare name and the དཔལ་ལྡན་ form so the honorific is not later dropped or coined differently.

Four occurrences across p0366–p0367 (ཚོགས་གཉིས་རྒྱ་ཆེན་པོ, ཚོགས་ཐམས་ཅད, ཚོགས་བསགས་པ, ཚོགས་ཡོངས་སུ་རྫོགས). NO entry for bare ཚོགས in the accumulation sense; the glossary carries it only inside compounds (ཡོན་ཏན་གྱི་ཚོགས = tư lương công đức, ཚོགས་བསག = tích tập tư lương, བྱང་ཆུབ་ཀྱི་ཚོགས = tư lương bồ-đề, ཡེ་ཤེས་ཀྱི་ཚོགས = tư lương trí, ཚོགས་གསོག་པའི་ཞིང), and one of those notes already asks for the accumulation sense to be distinguished from ཚོགས = assembly/gathering. 'tư lương' is used consistently in c010, c023–c025, c027–c029, c035, c039, c041–c042, c047–c048, c057, c061–c062, c067, c110 and this chunk. Kept; register bare ཚོགས and the compound ཚོགས་གཉིས = 'hai tư lương' so a later chunk does not produce 'hai bồ tư lương' or 'tích tập' for the noun, and so the assembly sense stays separable.
p0369. The disciple who reports Atiśa's answer. Tibetan name left in transcription, following the precedent for Naktso / Drolungpa / Geshe Tönpa. Unregistered.
p0370, as the title in བཙུན་པ་ཟླ་བ. No entry for the bare monastic title (glossary has only ཚིག་བཙུན་པ). Kept distinct from སློབ་དཔོན = A-xà-lê and དགེ་བཤེས = Geshe.

p0370, named alongside སློབ་དཔོན་ཟླ་བ་གྲགས་པ (Nguyệt Xứng / Candrakīrti) and Kamalaśīla. The Tibetan says only 'the venerable Zla ba'. NOT resolved to Candragomin in the text — c014 uses 'Candragomin' only where the Tibetan itself reads ཙནྡྲ་གཽ་མི (p0049). See flag.
p0371, སྙིང་སྟོབས་ཀྱི་བསམ་པ་ལྷག་པའི་ལྷག་བསམ — the courage by which the superior intention surpasses ordinary love and compassion. Unregistered.
p0371–p0372, the pit in the only-son simile and its referent, the three realms. མི་གཙང་བ = bất tịnh, དོང = hố.

terms.vi: chẳng sánh được dù chỉ đại khái
terms.note: p0369, in the Mātṛceṭa verse (དེ་གཞན་སྐྱེ་བོས་འོལ་མི་དབྱི). Follows the only other occurrence in the corpus, p0166 འོལ་ཡང་མི་དབྱི་ཆར་ཡང་མི་ཕོད, which c052 renders 'Cũng chẳng giống được đại khái, cũng chẳng bằng nổi một phần'. Same instrumental-agent pattern, so rendered consistently. See flag.
p0372. No entry, but 'ba cõi' is the settled corpus rendering (c004, c044, c062, c083).
p0370. Deliberately NOT collapsed into the glossary's ཡིད་དུ་འོང་བ = 'khả ái', although the passage uses the two almost interchangeably; kept separate so the Tibetan wording stays visible.

terms.vi: nhớ nghĩ ân đức / báo đáp ân đức
terms.note: p0370, the second and third of the seven-point sequence. Non-honorific དྲིན, so built on the glossary's བཀའ་དྲིན = 'ân đức' but without the honorific register of བཀའ་དྲིན་རྗེས་སུ་དྲན་པ = 'tùy niệm ân đức'.
p0369–p0370, ~6×; the technical term for being unable to bear another's suffering, which is what compassion is built from. Unregistered.
p0372, སྐྱུག་བྲོ་བ་མེད་པར in the sūtra — the father enters the filth 'without disgust'.
p0372. Built on the glossary's དགྲ་བཅོམ་པ = A-la-hán. The Tibetan does not name which two; not expanded to 'thanh văn và Độc Giác'.

terms.vi: Cách thức các nhân quả khác trở thành nhân và quả của điều ấy
terms.note: Outline s130, path 6.2.3.1.9.2.1.1.2, level 8 → '##' (the chunk's shallowest section is level 7). དེའི refers to compassion, established as the root in the preceding section, but the heading says only 'its', so it is rendered 'của điều ấy' rather than resolved.

terms.vi: Thực sự tu tập theo trình tự
terms.note: Outline s131, path 6.2.3.1.9.2.1.2, level 7 → '#'. དངོས = 'thực sự', following the closest structural precedents བསམ་པ་སྦྱང་བ་དངོས → 'Thực sự tu tập ý lạc' (c081) and སྡུག་བསྔལ་བསྒོམ་པ་དངོས → 'Việc tu tập về khổ thực sự' (c083); རིམ་ཅན་དུ = 'theo trình tự', following the glossary's རིམ་པ = 'trình tự'.

terms.vi: tu tập cái trí mong cầu lợi ích cho kẻ khác / tu tập cái trí mong cầu bồ-đề / nhận diện sự phát tâm, tức quả của việc tu tập ấy
terms.note: p0372, the three-fold division announced at the end of the chunk. The first is worded to match c114, which already renders that heading 'Tu tập cái trí mong cầu lợi ích cho kẻ khác'. See flag: that uses བློ = 'cái trí', not the glossary's བློ་སྦྱང་བ = 'tu tâm'.

KEPT. p0370 l.1: 'không thấy có sự xác định về nhân quả'. The registered entry ངེས་པ = 'sự xác quyết' (provisional) is scoped by its own note to the ascertainment-by-a-knower sense, which is what the chunk uses at p0369 (ངེས་པ་རྙེད་ན / ངེས་པ་རྙེད་པ / ངེས་པ་བརྟན་པོ་བཙལ). Here ངེས་པ is a fixed entailment holding BETWEEN cause and effect, not an act of a mind. Needs a scoped second-sense ruling, not a rewrite.

KEPT. p0370 l.1. glossary.json has only ཚིག་བཙུན་པ = 'lời nói được tôn trọng'; no ruling for བཙུན་པ as an honorific title, which needs to sit alongside the existing སློབ་དཔོན = 'A-xà-lê' / སློབ་དཔོན་ཆེན་པོ = 'đại A-xà-lê' pair.
KEPT. p0371 l.1. glossary.json has only the set ཚད་མེད་བཞི = 'bốn vô lượng'; the modifier used on its own has no ruling.
KEPT. p0371–0372, རང་གི་ཁུར་དུ་ལེན་པ / ཁུར་ཁྱེར་བ ('nhận lấy làm gánh nặng của chính mình', 'gánh vác gánh nặng'). No entry; it is the load-bearing image of the whole adhyāśaya section.
